articleTitle: Waterbody Area Segmentation of Satellite Images Using U-Net with Dense Block Enhanced Encoder
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This paper presents an advanced approach for waterbody segmentation in satellite images using a Dense U-Net model with a Dense Block-enhanced encoder. Accurate segmentation of water areas in satellite imagery is crucial for environmental monitoring, flood management, and resource planning. Traditional U-Net models are effective but often lack the capacity to capture fine details required for high-resolution satellite data. To address this, the proposed Dense U-Net replaces standard convolutional layers in the encoder with Dense Blocks, promoting feature reuse and deeper extraction of spatial information. Additionally, multi-scale fusion is incorporated to handle various spatial scales, enabling the model to accurately segment both large and small water regions. The simulation outcome shows that the proposed method segments the waterbody region with high Accuracy (96.7%), Recall (95.4%), and Dice coefficient (96.1%), with robust Specificity (99<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and F1 scores (96.6%), underscoring its balanced performance in segmenting water regions. Performance metrics indicate the model's effectiveness in isolating water areas with minimal false positives and accurate boundary delineation. This enhanced approach provides a reliable solution for detailed waterbody segmentation in satellite images.

articleTitle: Quantum Computing Applications in Financial Modeling and Portfolio Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In this decade the classical computers can surpass the computational power anticipated using quantum computers, bringing transformative advancements across multiple industries, with finance expected to be the first to reap the benefits. Notably, the quantum computer poised in the financial sector leveraging medium and long terms usually but sometimes in short term. The present study involves the quantum computing applications in financial modelling and portfolio optimization using classical convex optimization algorithmthat focus on the current advancement of quantum computationsin financial modelling. The key areas focused by quantum computing includes machine learning optimization and stochastic modelling. It explodes the quantum computing techniques adopted with solutions that can enhance the problem-solving skills in finance sector like fraud detection, natural language processing, portfolio optimization, risk modelling, derivative pricing that improves both efficiency and accuracy. Additionally, we examine the practicality of implementing these algorithms on near-term quantum computers across different hardware architectures and highlight their relevance to a diverse range of financial use cases.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach Using MATLAB on Robotics Control and Navigation for Autonomous Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Smart autonomous robotics must be able to navigate in complicated surroundings. Developing complex navigational platforms to transport autonomous robotics from one location to another has taken years of engineering and study. Notwithstanding their general effectiveness, a new area of study is focused on creating machine learning (ML) methods to deal with the identical issue. Nevertheless, there hasn't been any direct evaluation of the developing and traditional approaches to this issue up to this point. Since the optimum management issue has gained popularity as a study topic, reinforcement learning (RL) methods are preferred for supervised learning in the ML field due to the impossibility of selecting every possible solution for continuous-state issues and the lack of a specified trainer. This work proposes an approach to tackle autonomous robotic navigation using the 2 most widely used RL methods, Sarsa <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\boldsymbol{\lambda})$</tex> and Q <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\boldsymbol{\lambda})$</tex>. To boost efficiency, the suggested framework, built using MATLAB, utilizes condition and action collections that are constructed uniquely. Both in simulation and real-world settings, the platform has an elevated performance percentage in navigating autonomous robotics to a specified destination by overcoming barriers. Furthermore, it is feasible to compare the results of the Sarsa and Q techniques and evaluate how the starting variables employed by the RL techniques, such as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}$</tex>, affect learning.

articleTitle: Optimizing Fog Computing Performance: A Machine Learning-Based Task Scheduling Approach Using Fuzzy Logic and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The ability to deliver results promptly has become crucial for analytical frameworks due to the swift increase in data volumes. Complex algorithms are needed to schedule data processing activities on distributed compute clusters efficiently. Because it is impractical to create and fine-tune a scheduling policy for every task, current systems rely on basic, generic heuristics and neglect workload peculiarities. Effective task scheduling is essential for optimising the performance of fog computing systems. Fog nodes are dynamic, heterogeneous, and resource-constrained, and traditional task scheduling techniques, which were largely created for centralised cloud settings, frequently cannot accommodate these characteristics. We provide a cutting-edge machine learning (ML) based solution that adjusts job assignment to the evolving needs of the Fog environment in order to get beyond these restrictions. Fuzzy logic, a reliable unsupervised learning method, is used with the K-Means clustering algorithm in our method to effectively group. We have used Python to model and assess our suggested method. The simulation findings validate the effectiveness of our scheduling method, demonstrating notable improvements in response time, reduced network usage, and execution time reduction in comparison to other ML and non-ML based scheduling techniques available in the Python framework.

articleTitle: MATLAB-Based Simulation of Generative AI-Based Autonomous Vehicle Control for High-Speed Driving and Emergency Maneuvers
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Recently, the automobile industry has been investigating the idea of autonomous vehicles extensively as a means of, for increasing gas mileage or gaining access to areas that are dangerous for human drivers. The autonomous industry has not widely adopted these methods despite the fact that they clearly provide improved control efficiency. This is because their first end-user adoption frequently poses significant obstacles. Although System Predictive Management (SPM) has historically been employed to regulate models with shorter dynamics, it is currently also being utilized in models with significantly quicker dynamics due to the development of stronger processors. A weight adaptable SPM depending on the PSO-BP neural network is developed in this study to enhance the monitoring adaptability of self-driving vehicles beneath varying road shape and vehicle high-speeds. It is composed of an optimum-weight adaptable regulating and a dynamics-oriented SPM. The PSO-BP NN is trained offline using the optimum load beneath various operational circumstances determined by automatic simulation in order to accomplish the online modification of SPM load. This approach depends on the employment of SPM to accomplish high-precision monitoring management. The adaptable management structures outperform the original conventional SPM regulation in terms of monitoring adaption, according to the test outcomes of the Prescan-Carsim-Simulink combined simulated system. The adaptable management approach increased monitoring speed while satisfying the vehicle's needs for real-time management and lateral security, according to the evaluation outcomes from an automated vehicle investigation system where the management method was additionally validated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Acquisition Algorithms Using IRNSS Data
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Increase in the new Global/Regional Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS/RNSS) has lead to the design of software receivers for the research and development purpose. GNSS Satellites transmit the navigation signals which contain the information about satellites position and health. The navigation data is modulated using pseudo random noise (PRN) signals and transmitted on air using Radio Frequency(RF) signals. A typical GNSS/RNSS receiver contains important blocks viz. RF fornt end block, signal processing block and navigation data processing block. RF front end receives signal and down converts to Intermediate frequency(IF) and gives it to ADC. Signal processing block receives digitised signal form ADC at IF with a suitable sampling frequency and processes further to remove the moduation and get the navigation data. The last block extracts satellite position information from navigation data. The first stage of the signal procesing block is acquisition where the the frequency value of the actual carrier and code phase value of the pseudorandom noise sequence are extrated which are the prime inputs for further blocks of signal processing. Hence it is very impotrtant to understand the acquisition process while designing a receiver. This paper discusses the three basic methods of acquisition along with its mathematical background using Real IF data for analysis. The data is collected by IRNSS-UR (IRNSS- User Receiver) hardware installed at IRNSS laboratory in Jain University Campus by ISRO (Indian Space Research Organization) and performs the analysis in detail. The results of all three methods are compared and are found very near to the expected values. This work provides a very good reference for an aspirant or a researcher who wishes to work on GNSS receivers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Security Implementing AI-Based Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The increasing complexity of assaults necessitates the use of innovative intrusion detection systems (IDS) to safeguard critical assets and data. There is a higher risk of cyberattacks like data breaches and unauthorised access since cloud services have been used more frequently. The project's goal is to find out how Artificial Intelligence (AI) could enhance the IDS's ability to identify and classify network traffic and identify anomalous activities. Online dangers could be identified with IDS. An intrusion detection system, or IDS, is required to keep networks secure. We must create efficient IDS for the cloud platform as well, since it is constantly growing and permeating more aspects of our daily life. However, using standard intrusion detection systems in the cloud may provide challenges. The pre-established IDS design may overburden a cloud segment due to the additional detection overhead. Within the framework of an adaptively designed networked system.We demonstrate how to fully use available resources without placing undue load on any one cloud server using an intrusion detection system (IDS) based on neural networks. To even more successfully detect new threats, the suggested IDS make use of neural network machine learning (ML).

articleTitle: Evaluating the Impact of Influencer Marketing Using Social Network Analysis (SNA) Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The way businesses plan their advertisements has changed as a result of the rapid rise in the number of consumers on different social networking sites. Businesses are currently focusing on influencer marketing (IM), which involves hiring freelance celebrities to market their items on social networking sites, to capitalize on the enormous scale of online communities. Online social media accounts for a sizable portion of human communication. Thus, this research examines the impact of IM (such as., posts) are quantified by the quantity of likes and responses. In this study, the Gradient Boosted Decision Tree (GBDT) and the Chaos Gradient-oriented Algorithm (CGOA) are used. Additionally, this investigation offers a GBDT-CGOA paradigm and a productive way to find individuals who have the power to impact other people's conduct in the future. By employing a system that measures and predicts users' popularity in various areas and at various points employing machine learning algorithms and semantic evaluation, this research aims to identify domain-oriented social influencers for marketing. The outcomes demonstrate the effectiveness and utility of the GBDT-CGOA approach. The investigation's findings indicate that the GBDT-CGOA system is capable of accurately classifying ambiguous statistics, which expedites and improves processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Thermal Management Systems for an Electric Vehicle Battery
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Battery thermal management (BTM) is crucial for maintaining the optimal temperature range within an electric vehicle (EV) battery. It ensures the safety, efficiency, and longevity of the battery cells, which are sensitive to temperature variations. Effective BTM systems help mitigate risks such as thermal runaway, and fire hazards due to hot weather. It also ensures consistent performance under diverse operating conditions. This paper presents the sophisticated design and implementation of a thermal management system for an electric bike battery. The design has been analyzed both in open-loop and closed-loop. Simulation has been carried out using MATLAB Simulink/ Simscape® environment. The results have shown that the Li-ion battery is operated within the operating range of 20 to 30°C with the application of UDDS drive cycles.

articleTitle: Application of Wide Bandgap in Power Electronics: Next-gen Smart Grids

abstract: Electric vehicles would need sophisticated, enhanced rapid charging facilities and battery innovation before being widely used. articleTitle: Enhancing Physical-Layer Security in 6G Networks Through Integrating Irregular Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Recently, both business and academics have shown an immense amount of interest in reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) because of its affordability and versatility in modifying the amplitude and phase of wireless signals using inexpensive passive reflecting components. For 6G wireless communication networks, several RIS-assisted methods have been put out to increase data throughput and energy efficiency. Regarding a time-division duplex (TDD) downlink cellular wire-tap network, that comprises of one base station (BS) that has several antennas, several legitimate parts for user equipment (UE), numerous eavesdroppers (EVEs) & several RISs, researcher present an innovative RIS depended channel randomization (RCR) technique in this research to improve physical-layer security (PLS). The terahertz (THz) radio region could be utilized at 6G net, researcher assume that there is only a line-of-sight (LOS) path among RISs, UE and BS. As part of the suggested method, each RIS creates several reflection matrices in a pseudo-random way and then uses for the pilot signal duration (PSD) at the uplink & the data transmission duration (DTD) at the downlink. For each reflection matrix, the BS figures out the UE's wireless channels using all of the RIS's reflection matrices and chooses the UE with an optimal secrecy rate. The presented method achieves higher levels of privacy compared to standard methods.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality-Assisted Pediatric Surgery: A Machine Learning-Based Approach for Enhancing Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Numerous advancements have been identified as potentially disruptive innovations in the surgical workplace as surgical workflow continues to improve in the digital age. The application of virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) within health care to enhance the use of data for medical reasons is unavoidable given their rapid expansion in availability, affordability, and accessibility. Using augmented reality may help paediatric orthopaedic and trauma surgeons overcome the difficult problem of comprehending the spatial linkages among the implants, anatomy, and their instruments. As needs be, the current examination proposes another AR of the surgical scene that deftly incorporates the various information sources given by a mobile C-arm and a Kinect RGB-depth sensor. This paper present a learning-based worldview to perceive the significant items or life structures in both Kinect and data of X-ray, and to produce an object unambiguous pixel-wise alpha guide that permits importance based combination of the X-ray pictures and the video inside a solitary view. We demonstrate very encouraging results in 10 simulated procedures with the goal of giving physicians a better grasp of the surgical environment and an enhanced perception.

articleTitle: Analysis of Feedback and Re-Circulating Buffer Based Optical Packet Switch
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In optical packet switching (OPS), contention is major phenomenon where more than one packet tries to occupy the same output port. This paper introduces a new design for an optical packet switch based on hybrid buffering strategy. In this hybrid scheme both Feedback and Re-Circulating buffers are used to hold the contending packets. OPS is a latest transmission technology which is based on the optics and provide high bandwidth and very low latency. However, as the traffic conditions varies continuously, therefore a key challenge is to design buffering strategy. In this study, we explore how combining the benefits of both Feedback and Re-Circulating buffers can improve the overall performance of OPS. The performance of the switch is measured in terms of packet loss probability. By looking at packet loss and buffer usage under different traffic conditions, main aim to understand the impact of this hybrid approach. Our results show that using both types of buffers in the same switch leads to a lower chance of packet loss, improving the overall network performance. We found that the proposed design performs better in terms of packet loss probability compared to other approaches.

articleTitle: Advanced Encryption Techniques for Protecting Sensitive Data in Multi Cloud Architecture: A Security First Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: “Cloud computing” refers to a broad range of computer ideas that include several PCs linked by a real-time transmission network, such the internet. Cloud computing is a new paradigm that has drawn a lot of attention from researchers recently due to its potential to lower computing expenses.This study compares RSA, AES, and a technique that combines both of them. The effectiveness of these methods is examined in relation to encryption and decryption times for various data set sizes. The experiment was designed to be replicable and was conducted on standardised devices using the Mathematical writing and analysis tool, which is based on the Wolfram Language. In this experiment, encryption and decryption speeds were tested and compared for data sizes ranging from 64 to 176 bytes. As a second indicator of the algorithms' performance, the number of iterations each algorithm completed was also counted.The results demonstrate that AES had the fastest encryption and decryption times, and that the hybrid model had the greatest features of both RSA and AES in terms of speed and security. With encryption times of 0.10 ms and 0.20 ms for 64-byte and 176-byte data, respectively, the hybrid approach provided a balanced performance. AES outperformed RSA in throughput by up to 4 times and the hybrid technique by up to 2 times. According to these results, the hybrid technique successfully strikes a balance between speed and security, even though AES is best for speed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Electric Discharge Machining Process Parameters Using Simulated Annealing Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The Simulated Annealing (SA) Optimisation Algorithm is used in this project to optimize the Electrical Discharge Machining process parameters. The primary goal is to improve the Material Removal Rate (MRR) while reducing Surface Roughness (SR), which are two essential performance indicators in EDM. Because MRR and SR are competing objectives, the optimisation attempts to strike a balance by selecting optimal parameter choices. The objective function is developed using Regression Analysis (RA) and the SA algorithm. When machining settings are optimised, MRR and SR show considerable improvements. The workpiece is made of AISI 4340 steel, and the electrodes are made of copper. The SA approach produced results that closely matched experimental data. A comparative analysis of outcomes from the Genetic Algorithm (GA), SA, and experimental methods is also presented, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed optimization strategy.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Decision Support Systems for Project Management in Automobile Engineering

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Data Structure for Efficient Query Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Organisations are flooded with enormous amounts of data from many sources in the big data era. Effective query processing strategies are crucial for deriving significant insights and guiding well-informed judgements. MapReduce and other big data analytical tools have emerged as key concerns for numerous businesses and research teams. At the moment, similar tasks are submitted repeatedly using multi-queries that are converted into MapReduce jobs. Therefore, taking use of these related tasks may present opportunities to avoid performing MapReduce calculations repeatedly. Since then, other analyses have focused on the sharing possibility to improve multi-query processing. Therefore, the primary goal of this work is to thoroughly examine and distinguish between two predicate-based filter-based sharing opportunity strategies that are already in use: relaxed MRShare and MRShare. As far as predicate-based filters among multi-query questions, the relaxed MRShare technique performs noticeably better than the MRShare for shared data, according to a comparative study conducted using the TPC-H benchmark.

articleTitle: Efficient Energy Distribution Through Integration of Demand Response System and Renewable Energy Sources in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Customers can now configure their household devices to react to demand response systems (DRSs) provided by distribution system managers (DSMs) that are connected with renewable energy resources (RERs) due to the development of smart grids (SGs). A likelihood density functioning is suggested to forecast the actions of solar and wind power resources to attain optimal outcomes. DRSs are suggested with the participation of households, businesses, and commercial customers to address the ambiguity in energy generated by solar and wind RERs. This study implemented incentive-based compensation as price-based packets in this approach to implement DRSs. Operational expense and carbon emission distribution simulated are broken down into 3 stages: (i) application of the multifaceted genetic algorithm (MFGA) to solve the distribution issues; (ii) efficiency of operational expenses and carbon emission without DRSs; and (iii) efficiency of functioning expense and carbon emission with DRSs. To support the use of the suggested MFGA-based optimizing methodology, a smart grid that serves businesses, factories, and household customers is used. The present approach, which depends on the multifaceted particle swarm optimizing (MFPSO) method, is also contrasted with the suggested MFGA-based optimal system in terms of carbon emissions and operating costs. Compared to the current paradigm depending on the MFPSO method, the suggested MFGA-based optimizer functions better in terms of carbon emissions and operating costs. According to empirical findings, MFGA reduces carbon emissions and operating costs by 29% and 25%, respectively, with and without DRS involvement.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Generic Plant Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: With advances in the globalization of the world market, several new varieties of crop cultivation have popped up. The advances have led to habitat changes, and new varieties of diseases and plants have surfaced to challenge the farmer community. Several advancements have been made to assist today's agriculture. One among them is the utilization of learning-based models to identify plant diseases. However, the literature review shows that studies were carried out to identify specific diseases in particular plants. The exacting models failed to achieve cross-identification of the diseases irrespective of the type of plant. Thus, the proposed study focusses on novel classifier intending towards generic plant disease classification across various crops. The study was trained and tested for mildew, spot, and rot diseases. Through the training and testing for seven plants and blind validation across six other plants, an accuracy of 96.43% in testing and 63% accuracy in validation was obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of Smart City Solutions for Sustainable Urban Growth in India
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Over the past three decades, India's cities have benefited from increased urban investment in terms of better economic conditions and infrastructure. Nonetheless, the cities are also dealing with issues of uneven and polarized growth benefits distribution. This paper proposes a multidimensional framework for monitoring and evaluation, also it expands the objective of inclusive cities beyond the confines of “pro-poor development”. The article explores the need of smart city solutions to promote sustainability and efficiency in rapidly growing cities. It focuses on resource management, environmental impact, and quality of life. The paper concludes with recommendations for cities adopting these solutions, emphasizing the importance of combining new technologies with traditional methods and public engagement.

articleTitle: Thermal Stability of Micropolar Fluid Layer in the Presence of Horizontal Magnetic Field Under Variable Gravity
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This research paper explores the thermal stability of a thin layer of non-conducting, incompressible micropolar fluid, which is heated from below and subjected to a uniform horizontal magnetic field under a varying gravity field. The study derives a dispersion relation for a flat fluid layer situated between two free boundaries, employing a linear stability analysis theory and a normal mode analysis method. The investigation examines the impact of different factors, including the magnetic field, coupling parameter, micropolar heat conduction parameter, and micropolar coefficient, on the onset of stationary convection under variable gravity. The results are presented in graphical form, validating the Principle of Exchange of Stability (PES). Additionally, the study establishes sufficient conditions for the non-existence of overstability. This research contributes to the understanding of thermal stability in micropolar fluids under varying gravity and magnetic fields, offering valuable insights for future studies in this area.

articleTitle: Strategic Integration of IoT and AI: Optimizing Techno Management for Enhanced Organizational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Building safety in factories, which are based on new technologies like machine learning (ML) and the Internet of Things (IoT), is becoming the next generation of safety methods. This study offers a novel framework for improving safety control on construction sites by combining machine learning to know models with IoT technology. Numerous sensors, such as as pressure, temperature, fireplace, vibration, and proximity sensors, are positioned strategically to show important safety characteristics in real time. To improve threat prediction skills, the study uses machine learning, notably RF, ANN, KNN, and LR. According to the results, ANN records 95.6%, KNN records 90.9%, LR records 87.45%, and RF achieves the best accuracy of 97.7%. Notably, RF performs better overall and shows that it can adapt its protection strategies to different building conditions. By combining real-time sensor data with cutting-edge machine learning techniques, the integrated method offers a strong safety net that proactively identifies and reduces risks, improving overall safety in building sites. In other words, a safe worksite fosters a more focused and productive working environment.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of MIMO-OFDM System with Perfect Channel Estimation Using Delayed Feedback
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Using multiple broadcast and capturing antennas to create MIMO channels can enhance capacity by a factor equal to the smaller of the number of broadcasting or capturing elements. To reduce inter-symbol interference and increase system capacity, Subcarrier-Based Transmission Technique (OFDM) is employed in MIMO channels (MIMO-OFDM) to enable efficient wideband transmission in this study. Two separate space-time codes are used by the MIMO-OFDM system for two sets of two broadcasting antennas. Pre-whitening and Closest-point interpretation based on Iterative interference suppression are used at the receiver to decode the separate space-time codes. The primary goal of this work is to estimate the ideal channel utilising delayed feedback, in which the transmitter and receiver estimate the feedback. Guard bits are used here for the OFDM signals. We discovered that LS is a perfect channel by examining the estimators' results in MATLAB. Thus, the optimal method for channel estimation is delayed feedback. Additionally, the experimental results guarantee improved performance when a MIMO-OFDM system employs Delayed Feedback and Channel Estimation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a User Centered Design Framework for Software Development
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The concept and methodology known as Usercentred Design (UCD) puts the user at the center and concentrates on cognitive aspects as they relate to how people interact with objects. In order to overcome biassed decisionmaking, automated AI-based decision support systems need to be able to be used, trusted, and accepted. Design criteria for AI-based decision support systems in traditional craftsmanship are therefore required. In this contribution, we examined the relationships between user acceptance and a user-centred design by evaluating three distinct applications in a mixedmethod user research (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{N} \mathbf{D}=20$</tex>) that included both qualitative (think aloud) and quantitative (survey) components. Starting with research-related planning agreements, the context is established by interviewing the parties who agreed in the first stage, the needs are ascertained through user assessments, the System Usability Scale (SUS) method is used to determine the results, a prototype is designed based on the findings of the third step, and UI evaluation is conducted using the same method when evaluating the UI AI running in the third stage to demonstrate whether or not there has been a significant improvement. It took into account technological adoption, usability, and planning objectivity and efficiency. The findings imply that while AI-based decision support systems improve speed and objectivity, usability, acceptance, and confidence depend on user-centred design. Given that automated options were not as often questioned, it makes sense to give the decision maker the last say. It produces practical recommendations for the development of AI-based manufacturing support systems.

articleTitle: Investigating the Effects of Social Media on Mental Health
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Social networks have indeed become an integral part of our lives, with more than 3 billion people catering to this network. Although it has many advantages for maintaining relationships with friends and families, spreading information, and accessing news and entertainment, it has also led to an alarming problem, i.e., negative effects on mental health. To understand the effect of social media on mental health, we have used the logistic regression model and Gaussian Bayes models to extract the important features. It contains a review of various research that addresses the issues of positive and negative impacts of social media, and examines the conclusions derived from these studies on public, policy, and clinical decision making. We have utilized Logistic Regression and Gaussian Bayes model for calculating the accuracy and performed a comparative study to find the better model. In the case of Logistic Regression it provides 99.3% accuracy and for the Gaussian Bayes model it is providing 94% accuracy. Study concludes, that logistic regression can better capture the features for understanding the effect of social media on mental health.

articleTitle: Automating Documentation Maintenance: Implementing Hyperlink Testing via GitHub Actions
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This paper addresses the testing phase of the Software development life cycle, mainly focusing on identifying the broken links in documentation. Broken links cause serious issues that can bring down the integrity of the documentation, so it is required to regularly check for broken links in documentation. Current methods for detecting broken hyperlinks in documentation often rely on manual checks, which can be time-consuming and prone to human error. This paper introduces a practical approach for automatically detecting broken hyperlinks in documentation files using GitHub Actions. The goal is to automate the identification of links with 404 error (i.e. Page not found) and invalid path reference issues, ensuring high-quality documentation in collaborative software projects. By incorporating this method into continuous integration and continuous Deployment workflows, it can automatically detect broken hyperlinks before integrating and publishing new documents, thus maintaining the documentation integrity.

articleTitle: Optimizing Composite Verbal English Teaching Through Modular Design
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: To work on the nature of verbal English preparation and advance the improvement of compound application-situated capacities in schools and colleges, this examination coordinates the idea of conceive design implement operate (CDIO) into school English verbal guidance. Initial, an exhaustive outline of the CDIO instructive idea is given. An illustration plan is recommended by the CDIO idea after the MFO (moth-flame optimisation) approach and its SVM (support vector machine) approach, which is used for showing assessment, is introduced. At long last, the precision of the MFO-SVM model for showing assessment is confirmed through examination of reenactments, and an outline of the related showing strategies is given by teaching assessment and plan customisation. The MFO-SVM model has a 97.52% precision rate in assessing the nature of guidance, while the ELM (extreme learning machine), SVM, and BPNN (back propagation neural network) models have exactness paces of 93.48%, 91.67%, and 87.45%, separately, as per the trial information. The advancement of compound application-arranged gifts and the flow change of verbal English schooling are fairly connected with this examination. The summarised exhibiting tactics come into four main categories: creation teaching, project-based learning, dynamic age and data criticism, and independent learning.

articleTitle: An Efficient Algorithm for Generating Interactive Visualization of Large Datasets
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Easy-to-use visualisation tools are essential for identifying patterns in unstructured data as it grows larger and more complicated. The majority of large data visualisation techniques either knowledge of a programming language or access to commercial tools. These days, data is growing in size, and statistical visualisation of the data needs numerous displays to represent all of the data's viewpoints. Model tuning, optimisation, and quick decision-making are greatly aided by the intriguing patterns produced by the models that are visualised. However, traditional techniques like histograms, pie charts, box plots, and bar graphs are typically insufficient to adequately communicate the intriguing pattern that needs to be extracted from massive datasets. As a result, this paper introduces a tree-plot method that uses the h2o package's in-memory node technique to store the enormous dataset in memory. Data. Tree's charting capabilities were employed to display the modelled trees, which were built using an Ada Boosted Model as the underlying learning methods. Visualising the modelled tree and evaluating the effectiveness of the data training process are based on the AUC, RMSE, execution procedure time, and MSE results.

articleTitle: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for Improved Financial Decision-Making in the Indian Mutual Fund Sector
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The mutual fund industry in India has grown at an exponential rate, making sophisticated analytical methods necessary for better financial decision-making. This research investigates how machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) systems can forecast important mutual fund efficiency indicators, such as returns, volatility, Sharpe ratios, and net asset value (NAV). We use metrics like R2 score, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Squared Error (MSE) to assess several systems, including XGBoost, Random Forest, Decision Trees, Linear Regression, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. With the lowest prediction error and a test R2 of 0.93, the results show that deep learning models-in particular, LSTM-perform better than conventional methods. Feature importance analyses also identifies historical returns, AUM, and NAV as important predictors. The results show how AI can improve investment methods, choose funds more wisely, and reduce risks. In India's changing investment environment, this study adds to the expanding area of AI-driven financial decision-making.

articleTitle: Predicting Diabetes Risk: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Nowadays, diabetes mellitus is a worldwide health concern that is becoming more common. Therefore, for better early detection techniques (Machine Learning) is need of hour. Six machine learning algorithms are applied in this article to forecast the likelihood of diabetes in three stages: prediabetes, diabetes, and no diabetes. Three metrics i.e., recall, F1 score and precision are applied to evaluate the algorithms performance. Additionally, we have used the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) for improving class imbalance. The results show that different algorithms and stages of diabetes function differently, which emphasizes the necessity of choosing algorithms according to the demands of certain applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Two-Area Interconnected Power Systems Using Model Predictive and PID Control Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This research represents a comparative study of Load Frequency Control (LFC) using Model Predictive Control (MPC). The results have also been compared with Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers. LFC is evident for power system stability which keeps equilibrium between generation and load. PID controllers are widely employed, however in the modern-day power systems which are complex in nature the performance of the PID controllers is not as par. Therefore, different control schemes have and are being explored. MPC is one of them techniques. The aim of this research is to evaluate and compare the effectiveness of MPC and PID controllers, in two-area system. A case study featuring a two-area system is presented to illustrate how the controllers respond to load conditions and disturbances. This paper aims to provide insights into the merits and limitations of each controller. The results contribute to a more profound comprehension of the practical implications associated with implementing MPC in LFC systems, thereby influencing future research and practical applications.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Project Portfolio Optimization for Sustainable Development: A Decision Support Framework
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence plays significant role in financial sector especially in sustainable development and financial planning. It replaces the conventional type of financial planning under portfolio optimization of projects through artificial intelligence techniques including deep learning robot advisors machine learning and in natural language processing. The study involves the decision support framework for AI driven project portfolio optimization for sustainable development. The applications of decision-making tools enabled with artificial intelligence helps in investment planning and projects with several algorithms it helps in risk management algorithmic trading prediction and forecasting of market securities asset management and personalised advice. The study utilises multi criteria decision making by integration of machine learning models for decision making and predictive analytics. It optimises the resource allocation over the projects and the balance the sustainability goals with risk factors. The real time monitoring is recorded for expected outcomes after implementation and the performance matrix for the key components are recorded for accuracy precision and recall. The key components such as performance efficiency and automation adaptability and flexibility and cost saving provided accuracy ranging from 90% to 95%.

articleTitle: Blockchain for Cybersecurity_ Securing Data Transactions and Enhancing Privacy in Digital Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The feasibility of using blockchain technology as a method to improve cybersecurity through data security transactions and users' anonymity is discussed in this paper. It scans network traffic, sings out abnormities, and uses the clustering approach to find cybersecurity risks. The identified evidence points to the prospects of blockchain to disrupt threat management and enhance the resilience of digital landscapes against cyber threats.

articleTitle: SupplyRx: Intelligent Pharmaceutical Inventory and Supply Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: To guarantee the availability of necessary medications and reduce waste in healthcare systems, effective management of drug inventory and supply chains is vital. The goal of the Drug Inventory and Supply Chain Tracking System is to make the distribution, storage, monitoring, and acquisition of pharmaceuticals more efficient Utilizing cutting-edge technologies, this system offers automated inventory updates, real-time tracking, and demand forecasting predictive analytics. By keeping precise records of medication movements and expirations, it improves regulatory compliance, guarantees supply chain transparency, and lowers the possibility of stockouts or overstocking. The architecture of the system incorporates modules for point-of-sale tracking, transportation logistics, warehouse operations, and supplier management. To further protect sensitive data, it integrates access control and user authentication and access control systems to protect private information. This technology helps healthcare organizations save money, enhance patient outcomes, and run more efficiently by promoting data-driven decision-making and resource optimization.

articleTitle: Development of Cyberattacks Detection Framework of Power Systems Using Optimal Features in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Smart grids (SG) are a kind of sophisticated cyber-physical system (CPS) that allows power systems to be operated and controlled remotely by integrating smart devices' communication capabilities into the grid. However, this integration reveals many shortcomings in conventional SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) structures, which could jeopardise security objectives and present a significant cyberthreat to the SG. Therefore, in order to prevent grid sabotage, early detection of cyberattacks is essential. Conventional techniques for identifying cyberattacks that take use of smart grid network characteristics include machine learning (ML) techniques. An effective and efficient security control method is put forth in this work to identify cyberattacks on the SG. To increase detection efficiency, irrelevant characteristics are eliminated using the correlation-based feature selection (CFS) method. Using the chosen best attributes, an instance-based learning (IBL) system distinguishes between typical and abnormal occurrences. Depends on a limited set of features extracted from power system measurements of SCADA, experimental findings demonstrate that the suggested method achieves a high detection rate.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Signal Processing Integration in Automatic Speech Recognition Framework Using Hidden Markov Models
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Automatic speech recognition is one of the technologies that change the game regarding the transcription of spoken language to text. A new methodology combining both feature extraction methods, including the Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and deep embedding, with acoustic modeling hybrid approach such as hidden Markov model (HMM) and DNN, shall be presented in the paper. The results exhibit excellent accuracy gains, up to 97.8% by the Transformer-based models in wide-ranging acoustic conditions. The obtained results underscore critical factors that come into play such as advanced preprocessing, feature extraction, and hybrid architectures to push ASR forward to more complicated noisy and noisy speech applications.

articleTitle: Predicting System Performance and Resource Exhaustion with Machine Learning: Tackling Class Imbalance
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This study introduces a robust machine learning pipeline for event classification, utilizing a large-scale dataset from eight Google Borg compute clusters (May 2019) available via Google Big- Query. The dataset includes detailed job submissions, scheduling decisions, and resource usage data, with enhancements such as 5-minute CPU usage histograms, shared resource reservations, and job- parent relationships critical for MapReduce task analysis. Data preprocessing involves imputation for missing values, label encoding for categorical data, and SMOTE to address the class imbalance. Feature scaling using StandardScaler and dimensionality reduction via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) retained 95% of the variance. The dataset was divided into training and testing sets, preserving class distribution. Seven machine learning models were evaluated, spanning linear, non-linear, ensemble, and neural network approaches. The Support Vector Machine (SVM) achieved exceptional performance, with 98.0% accuracy, 97.5% cross-validation score, 98.2% precision, 97.8% recall, and 98.0% F1-score. This study highlights the evolution of workloads and resource usage patterns, contributing to developing scalable and efficient event classification frameworks in cloud computing.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Blockchain Technology on Financial Transactions and Accounting Practices in Global Trade
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Financial transactions and accounting practises in global trade are transformed using blockchain technology with enhanced security efficiency and transparency. The study examines the role of Blockchain in real time financial reports smart contracts and cross border transactions by highlighting the potentiality to ensure regulatory compliance streamlined reconciliation process and fraudulence reduction. Decentralisation of financial data using blockchain enable record keeping a stamper proof and also minimises the transaction cost and the intermediaries and to accelerate the settlement times. The study explores the challenges such as integration regulatory uncertainties and scalability in the existing financial system. The study involves trade finance platforms and multinational corporations in reshaping the financial management and accounting standards using blockchain adoption in the global trade. The study employs mixed method approach for quantitative and qualitative analysis based on the ability of the blockchain to enhance the financial transactions in global trade.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Transfer Learning for Visual Multiple Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized high-level image processing tasks, notably image classification and segmentation, by effectively handling multi-dimensional features in image space. This report investigates the application of transfer learning, utilizing features extracted from a pre-trained VGG deep neural network to visual multiple-target tracking (MTT). Traditional feature detectors like the Lucas-Kanade Tracker and Good Features to Track (GFTT) algorithm are computationally efficient but limited in dynamic, cluttered environments, such as those encountered by unmanned aerial systems (UAS). Replacing GFTT with deep feature detectors from VGG is proposed to assess tracking accuracy and improve computational efficiency. Our experiments reveal that, though promising, deep feature extraction results in lower frame rates and less smooth trajectories than traditional methods. This study highlights the potential and current limitations of integrating deep learning features into real-time visual tracking systems. Plans include optimizing the deep learning model for real-time processing, automating filter selection for feature extraction, and exploring additional pre-trained networks to improve tracking performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of FIR Filter Utilizing Baugh Wooley Multiplier Integrated With Wallace Tree Configuration and Efficient Approximate Adders
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: FIR (Finite Impulse Response) filters play a crucial part in the field of digital signal processing, this is particularly important for areas such as audio processing, telecommunications, and image filtering. This paper explores the development and realization of an FIR filter using Verilog, with synthesis and verification carried out through the Vivado tool. The design utilizes Cutting-edge approximate arithmetic components, such as an approximate adder designed for efficiency in terms of area and power consumption (APEx) and an Approximate Baugh-Wooley multiplier integrated with Wallace Tree configuration designed for reversible logic, to optimize both area and delay in FPGA-based applications. Power consumption is further minimized through the application of clock gating techniques, enhancing overall performance. Experimental results reveal a substantial reduction in area and delay, while maintaining sufficient accuracy for practical applications. A comparative analysis of designs with and without clock gating demonstrates significant improvements in power efficiency, emphasizing the effectiveness of approximate arithmetic units and clock gating for low-power digital filtering solutions.

Author Keywords: Finite impulse response filtersAn approximate adder designed for efficiency in terms of area and power consumption (APEx)
Approximate Baugh-Wooley multiplier integrated with Wallace tree configuration

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Wireless Network Optimization: Algorithms and Applications for Adaptive Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This project looks into the possibility of applying machine learning to optimize wireless networks for adaptive communication. Using 5G resource data, it applies preprocessing, exploratory analysis, and visualization to identify key trends: signal strength, latency, and bandwidth utilization. Machine learning algorithms predict resource allocation based on latency-sensitive and bandwidth-demanding applications. The approach emphasizes energy efficiency, scalability, and service quality, and dynamically adjusts communication strategies to meet diverse network demands. The findings indicate the machine learning importance in enhancing elasticity and robustness in a wireless network and its general function.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stock Price Using XG Boost Integrated Bi-Channel LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Investors' biggest problem is determining the appropriate stock price by studying financial information, which is a difficult process due to enormous and related inefficiencies. So, among the biggest challenges for investors is identifying a stock. Currently, it's very challenging to carry out research in the forecasts for the finance industry, including the stock market, currency value, and stock price. Due to its critical importance in financial consumers' decision-making, the prediction and examination of the stock price is yet another important research subject. A novel Xgboost Integrated Bichannel Long/Short-Term Memory (X-BLSTM) technique is implemented in this article to provide a sophisticated and perfect framework for the share market's price prediction The share value dataset is the first thing we collect to assess the way the suggested X-BLSTM strategy performs. Due to the existence of noisy data, min-max normalization is performed to preprocess the raw dataset. The efficiency of the proposed approach is assessed using several measures, and comparative between the proposed and current methods is also provided. The studies' findings show that the recommended approach outperforms alternative techniques for share value prediction.

articleTitle: Development of Fake Network for Detection of Deep Fake Images and Videos with Advanced Computational Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Increased digitization leads to huge number of threats increasing along with it at faster pace. Deep fake videos and images generation may not require any computational device memory hardware or particular knowledge. But the process of detecting the deep fake video and images is challenging. Many methods have been evolved in recent times for solving these challenges but the computational costis very high for the highly efficient model. Thus, the proposed deep fake network model architecture involves highly efficient technique for accurate detection of deep fake video and imageswhich is comprised of linear stack of Max pooling and convolution layers. Activation function and Lime Gradient Boosting Machine (Light GBM) are used for the detection of deep fake videos. The develop model has high level of accuracy when compared with other models such as Efficient net and Xception and the study has been validated for the performance based on deep fake detection challenge data set. The study achieved 94.56% accuracy and 92.34% precision using this data set. Additionally, the study analyses the facial manipulations in the real-world images and videos accurately using advanced computational intelligence.

articleTitle: Intelligent Hiring Software- Job Recommendation System and Profile Builder
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In today's world, where there are multiple career options, still there is a difficulty in finding the securing and a good job that perfectly matches an individual's skill due to the absence of a very personalized recommendation systems. Additionally, the lack of proper guidance in making resumes, it is very much harder to find the best fit opportunity and get shortlisted for a company's hiring process. To alleviate those times consuming task, we develop and implement a job recommendation system for online job searching. This paper proposes a new method for overcoming these challenges by the development of Intelligent Hiring Software- job recommendation system and profile builder. By using the Naive Bayes our platform categorizes users according to their stated skills and profiles in their resumes and Hybrid approach of graph- based model enables job the recommendations. Natural Language Processing used for betterment of the resumes or profile buildup. Our Platform uses the NLP for profile improvement through the suggestions based on the previous profile and job description. Your career profile can be greatly improved using NLP.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-PI Based Energy Management System for a Fuel Cell-Battery Operated DC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The primary aim of this study is to design and analyze an Energy Management System (EMS) for a DC motor drive. The system under consideration features a primary energy source, a Fuel Cell (FC) supplemented by a battery storage system. Battery supplements power requirements during starting and energy recovery through regenerative braking. The system has two DC-DC converters: one unidirectional boost converter connected to FC and another bidirectional converter connected to the battery for both charging and discharging, with the motor being connected to the common DC bus. The control technique is implemented by a cascaded fuzzy and PI control which when implemented in this study effectively stabilizes voltage, improves power distribution and enhances adaptability of this EMS. The hTLBO-PS algorithm helps in optimizing the coefficients of the PI controller. This work is a step towards a broader call for enhancing the performance of Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs) by implementing advanced EMS techniques and addressing key global energy challenges.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Performance Management: Machine Learning Approaches for Employee Evaluation and Development
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This study explores how AI, primarily, the axiomatic realms of machine learning algorithms, is revolutionizing performance management systems. In most traditional systems, there are issues of bias, and poor performance and even the methodologies used are dated. The above-mentioned challenges are resolved in AI-powered solutions by improving the inherent objectivity of thinking. The real-time insights provided; the capacity to provide predictions. Supervised, as well as unsupervised learning enhances the method of employee assessment and reinforcement learning helps in enhancing self-development plans. This analysis shows that Random Forest and XGBoost models yield the best performance and have higher prediction accuracy. Although data may be prejudiced and there are a lot of ethical issues, AI provides a great opportunity to optimize the employee's job performance and their satisfaction with results for the organization's management.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning Algorithms for Sentiment Analysis in the Sphere of Cyberbullying Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The rise in cybercrimes targeting children is leading to devastating consequences like harmful behaviors and even suicide. While social media platforms offer reactive solutions like post deletion and blocking, a more proactive approach is needed. To combat cyber child abuse effectively we need technology-driven solutions that focus on detection and alerts to identify predators or protect victims. Various strategies have been proposed, including machine learning techniques that leverage sentiment analysis to detect patterns in the bully's language. This study explores the potential of machine learning to combat cyber child abuse by focusing on detection and alerts. We investigated the effectiveness of supervised, unsupervised, and ensemble learning algorithms for sentiment analysis in identifying abusive language. Analyzing a social media dataset for bullying detection, the research reveals that Support Vector Machines achieved the highest accuracy (83.26%) among supervised algorithms, with K-Nearest Neighbor (82.97%) and Random Forest Classifier (87.74%) performing best in the unsupervised and ensemble categories, respectively. The paper also addresses limitations and proposes future research directions.

articleTitle: Enhanced DeepFake Detection Using CNN and EfficientNet-Based Ensemble Models for Robust Facial Manipulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Deepfakes are generally powered by Generative adversarial networks (GANs) that has been newly introduced a new dimension of realism in the manipulation of digital media particularly in some delicate features such as eyes, lips, and skin texture. These sophisticated manipulations pose significant threats to digital security, privacy, and trust in media. Detecting these alterations, especially in still images, has become a critical focus of research. This paper presents a Convolutional neural network (CNN)-based approach to detecting facial feature manip- ulations in deepfake images. Leveraging CNN architectures like ResNet, we focus on identifying subtle pixel-level inconsistencies in facial regions. Preprocessing steps, including face cropping, alignment, and normalization, are applied to enhance the model's focus on manipulated features. Datasets such as Face Forensics++ are utilized for training and evaluation. Our model demonstrates a high level of accuracy in distinguishing real from fake images based on facial feature manipulations, outperforming baseline models in several key metrics, including precision and recall. The results highlight the effectiveness of CNNs in detecting fine- grained alterations and their potential for real-world application in combating deepfake threats.This research contributes to the ongoing efforts in deepfake detection by proposing a robust and scalable method to detect facial manipulations, ultimately enhancing the security and authenticity of digital media. Future work will explore the integration of multimodal detection tech- niques to further improve the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Stream Processing and Real Time Analytics in the Era of Data Engineering
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The prevalence of increased streaming of data revolutionises organisations approach with stream processing and real time analytics through actionable and immediate insights in the generated data streams. Advancements in data engineering drives the stream processing and real time analytics. The present study explores the transformative impact of real time analytics by examining the major components in stream processing and real time analytics such as visualisation tools, in-memory storage, stream processing and data ingestion. It enables the decision-making using data, optimised operations and personalised user experience. The study examines the multinational retail corporations and video streaming services for data engineering. The major advantages are competitive and operational efficiencies enhanced customer experience and rapid insights on stream processing. The tremendous potential is highlighted for implementation of real time analytics and stream processing with integration complexities, skill gaps, privacy and security concerns, systems scalability, enhanced data quality and management of data volume. Stream processing engine is used for higher throughput and lower processing latency based on workload.

articleTitle: Strategic Management of IT Investments in Electrical and Electronics: Aligning Operational Goals with Technological Advancements
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The manufacturing sector plays a significant role in the global economy. However, it confronts various problems, including inefficiencies in electrical and electronics engineering employment. Ineffectiveness causes interruptions, increased costs, and lost production. Device training strategic management can improve the planning and implementation of electrical and electronics sector activities in the building sector. This investigation aims to use technology to improve the effectiveness of electrical and electronics design initiatives in the manufacturing sector. The study will focus on designing and implementing electronic device mastery methods to improve plan organizing, fabric purchasing, and system usage. The capacity to use statistical analysis to detect and reduce risks associated with activities involving electric and electronic design will even be examined in this study. The anticipated outcome of this study is the creation of a set of strategies for the application of machine learning techniques to maximize electrical and electronics design initiatives in the building sector. Business executives, developers, and other shareholders in the creative business who are interested in increasing productivity and lowering costs associated with their work will find these recommendations useful. By investigating how system research strategies might improve electrical and electronics design activities, this research work typically seeks to support ongoing attempts to increase the productivity and effectiveness of the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: AI Driven Personalized Rehabilitation System Using Wearable Sensors for Real Time Physiotherapy Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Wearable artificial intelligence devices have a lot of promise for medical rehabilitation given the quick advancement of AI technology. The utilization of this sort of innovation in rehabilitation system for physiotherapy monitoring was researched utilizing progressed sensing advancements and information examination methods to furnish track and field athletes with more customized and logical rehabilitation programs. The examination plans to evaluate the impacts of constant following of wearable artificial intelligence devices on track and field athletes as well as investigate the conceivable utilization of these gadgets in the rehabilitation cycle. Ongoing checking of competitors' physiological states and athletic execution intends to give more precise and convenient data to rehabilitation suppliers. The study found that by real-time monitoring, wearable artificial intelligence technology greatly enhances the rehabilitation of track and field players. By employing real-time data monitoring, such as physiotherapy monitoring, physiological indicators, sports posture, and joint mobility, the rehabilitation team was able to identify potential problems and adjust the rehabilitation program more rapidly. According to the study's conclusions, track and field athletes can benefit from wearable AI method, which provides a more comprehensive and scientific approach to rehabilitation system for Physiotherapy monitoring. The rehabilitation team could better analyse the athletes' development, make targeted adjustments to the program, and enhance the therapy effect with the use of real-time tracking.

articleTitle: Building AI-Powered Recommendation Engines Within Salesforce Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: AI tool has become so useful and important for companies that it can either drive customers to a company or a company to a sale. This Recommendations Engine have become a crucial part of how to present the right recommendations to customers, to achieve better experience in Salesforce journey. So, many AI-powered recommendation engines extended within the Salesforce universe. These engines are usually very intelligent, utilizing advanced machine learning algorithms to apply customer data to make more personalized recommendations. Engines that integrate with Salesforce CRM can access a trove of customer data, enabling progressively more accurate and nuanced recommendations. Furthermore, AI-driven recommendation engines within the Salesforce ecosystem can be tailored to specific industry and business needs. For instance, in e-commerce, recommend engines suggest products interacts with customers browsing history and purchasing trends, as well as recommending tailored financial products and services in finance. While on the other hand AI-based recommendation engines present in the Salesforce ecosystem can further be said to implement improved internal processes for sales and marketing strategies as well as you can gain real-time access to customer preferences and behavior. This makes companies highly flexible and able to adapt to changing customer needs and tastes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Data Encryption Framework Simulink Model for Protecting Sensitive Organizational Data
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Internet-of-Medical-Things (IoMT) based sensitive data protection has become a critical problem lately. IoMT-sensitive data are used to connect patients with adults. Since every record, data, and healthcare signal is transmitted over these systems, they need strong and safe access methods for individuals to transmit their essential statistics or documents. Because of this, breaching these systems could have negative impacts on patients. An emerging pattern in biometric verification is to prevent using authentic biometrics for security purposes. Cancelable digital fingerprints can be created using a data encryption framework or non-invertible transformations. This study presents an integrated structure for cancelable ECG signal detection that is suitable for use in IoMT networking access steps. The suggested system uses fuzzy reasoning to perform a non-invertible transition on ECG data, altering its shifting spectrum. Cancellable biometric platforms aim to retrieve original ECG data from processing variants, but the procedure is non-invertible and hinders this goal. Next, customized trends are used to build compact encryption using XOR. This eliminates the complication of comprehensive encryption systems requiring significant computing resources. By combining encryption techniques and non-invertible transformations, the encryption phase improves the safety of cancelable biometrics features and permits the mixed nature of the suggested cancelable biometrics architecture. For the actual adoption of the suggested ECG-based cancelable biometrics identification structure, hardware adaptation is also shown. According to empirical findings, the suggested structure performs well, with an Equivalent Error Rate (EER) of 0.059%.

articleTitle: Development of Web Platform for Home Screening of Neurological Disorders Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide suffer with Parkinson's disease (PD), one of the most prevalent neurological illnesses. The diagnosis of PD has changed significantly over the last 25 years; at first, autopsy and neurological exams were the only methods accessible. Impaired handwriting has been shown to be a significant early indicator for this disease's identification. The purpose of this study was to use machine learning techniques to provide a quick and easy method of differentiating PD patients from controls using handwriting activities. It developed a telemonitoring technology based on user-friendly drawing tablet software that gave the subject visual feedback on the screen and enabled us to gather data in real time about the location, pressure, and tilt of the digital pen throughout the procedure. This paper created a procedure that included writing and drawing exercises, including ones in Italian, and we gathered information from ten PD patients and twenty healthy participants. With a 93.4% accuracy rate, the current research developed a machine learning (ML) framework that automatically separates PD patients from healthy control people using signals and data from a previous database.

articleTitle: A Gaussian Weighted Multi-Scale Method for Infrared Small Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Efficient and reliable infrared (IR) small target detection is crucial for infrared searching and tracking (IRST) systems. The existing detection methods generally still heavily rely on the pre-setting of reasonable parameters to ensure good detection performance. However, in real IR detection applications, target size information is often unknown. In this paper, a Gaussian weighted multiscale (GWM) is proposed to effectively reduce background clutter interference in multiscale detection while ensuring the effective detection of real IR targets. The correlation coefficient between the local region of the IR original image and the Gaussian model is proposed to constrain the selection of multiscale features.
