It is anticipated that the suggested framework will be useful for autonomous decision-making in a variety of robotics along with autonomous technologies where safety as well as optimality are important factors.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic-Based Deep Learning for Human-Machine Interaction and Gesture Recognition in Uncertain and Noisy Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Conventional deep learning methods have considerable hurdles when it comes to Human-Machine Interaction (HMI) and gesture identification in noisy and uncertain situations. A Fuzzy Logic-Based Deep Learning (Fuzzy DL) method is presented in this work to improve the resilience, accuracy, and adaptability of human gesture recognition in a variety of scenarios. We test several algorithms on various datasets, lighting situations, and noise levels, such as CNN, LSTM, Transformer, and Fuzzy DL. The outcomes show that Fuzzy DL functions better than other systems, retaining 91.0% accuracy at high noise levels and reaching 97.5% accuracy under typical circumstances. In comparison to traditional structures, it also shows faster inference times and a lower mean squared error. Its superiority is further demonstrated by comparative analysis on precision, recall, and F1-score. This study presents a robust and noise-resilient solution for real-world HMI applications, including as assistive systems and virtual interfaces. The outcomes indicate that incorporating fuzzy logic with DL substantially enhances gesture recognition in difficult environments.

articleTitle: Integrating Internet of Things (IoT) in Remote Dental Health Monitoring: A Smart Approach for Preventive Care
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: By facilitating real-time data gathering and evaluation, the Internet of Things' (IoT) incorporation in remote dental health monitoring is transforming preventive oral care. This research investigates a clever method for identifying early indicators of dental problems like cavities, gum disease, and plaque formation using IoT -enabled sensors and machine learning algorithms. A number of ML methods were assessed for computational efficiency, recall, precision, and predictive accuracy, comprising CNN, Random Forest, SVM, and XGBoost. With an AUC-ROC score of 0.98 and a test accuracy of 94.9%, the CNN model performed the best. IoT sensors, such as pressure and imaging sensors, were able to identify oral health issues with an accuracy of over 96%. To maximise IoT efficiency, energy use and false positive rates were also examined. Through ongoing, remote, and AI -assisted diagnostics, outcomes demonstrate how IoT -driven smart monitoring can lower dental dangers and encourage proactive care.

articleTitle: Hydrosense: Potable Water System with Monitoring for Remote Areas
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Potable water is a necessity for every living human being, but not everyone has access to it. Water undergoes a complex multi-stage filtration system to produce potable water that adheres to the potable water requirements set by health organizations. However, studies suggest that simple water filtration systems that use commonly available materials are still capable of producing potable water. This study focuses on developing a water filtration system and a water monitoring system powered by solar energy. Making it able to function independently from the electrical grid and making it deployable to remote areas. Using common filtration mediums such as activated carbon, silica sand, pebbles, and gravel, the water filtration system was proven to produce potable water, even without electrical water pumps. The water monitoring system is centered around the three water parameter sensors: pH, Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), and Turbidity sensors, from which the potability classification will be based. The water filtration system water samples have passed the potability standards after undergoing water laboratory testing. The water parameter values gathered by the water monitoring system have nearly matched with the results from the laboratory. An SMS alert was also sent to community members about the potability classification. The solar power system provided sufficient power to the prototype for at least one day-night cycle. HydroSense was able to achieve the goal of the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal 6, which pertains to providing access to clean and safe drinking water in even the remote parts of the globe, using water filtration and monitoring.

articleTitle: Advancing Predictive Maintenance and Asset Management Through Digital Twin Technology: A Step Towards Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are revolutionizing predictive maintenance (PdM) and asset management by creating a seamless link between physical and virtual systems. This study explores the use of DTs in integrating IoT sensor networks with advanced machine learning models such as Random Forest Classifiers, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and autoencoders. These technologies give meaningful insights into asset performance by enabling predictive analysis and real-time monitoring. The constraints of traditional maintenance techniques, such as delayed fault detection and poor resource allocation, have been addressed by DTs, which have shown notable benefits, such as a 20% increase in asset utilization and a 25% decrease in unscheduled downtime. Longer equipment lifespans and more economical maintenance techniques result from these devel-opments. Notwithstanding its potential, scalability and system integration issues still exist. DTs' critical role in improving system dependability, operational efficiency, and economic viability, all of which propel industrial advancement in the context of Industry 4.0, is highlighted in this paper.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Decision Making in Wellness Tourism: Understanding Consumer Preferences and Optimizing Tourism Strategies
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This study explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can enhance understanding of key factors in wellness tourism, focusing on attitudes, subjective norms, and behavioral intentions. Leveraging AI-driven data analytics, we analyze data from a sample of wellness tourists, employing structural equation modeling (SEM) to examine these factors' relationships. The findings demonstrate that AI can reveal significant insights into consumer attitudes, social influence, and behavioral intentions, shaping strategic approaches to wellness tourism promotion. The results provide actionable insights for destination marketers and wellness tourism providers, emphasizing AI's potential to personalize and optimize wellness tourism experiences.

articleTitle: Enhancing Energy Efficiency in IoT Networks with AI optimized LEACH Protocol and Digital Twin Simulation
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The convergence of the Internet of Things (IoT) via artificial intelligence (AI) will undoubtedly revolutionize networking. IoT is a technological paradigm shift facilitating the incorporation of many applications, including smart homes and wearable gadgets, via automation, wireless sensors, and embedded systems. Furthermore, the production of AI enhances this phenomenon by delivering data-driven insights, streamlining procedures, and creating new avenues for development. The extensive implementation of devices in Internet of Things (IoT) networks has raised worries over escalating energy usage. Utilizing environmentally friendly techniques is crucial to maintain network service for nodes that sense with limited power supplies. One approach that substantiates this assertion is LEACH, an acronym for Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy. The objective of this form of communication is to optimize the transfer of information to base sites by successfully configuring clusters within networks and executing real-time adjustments across cluster nodes. This work enhances the effectiveness of IoT systems by using a virtual twin simulation to optimize the protocol known as LEACH. Employ artificial intelligence analysis and virtual network models to evaluate power consumption and efficiency. Cache nodes are essential in this architecture since they receive information from the cluster's head & transmit it through the main hub. Utilizing simulation tools and artificial intelligence, we can enhance the reliability and energy efficiency of IoT devices. The results indicate an 84% decrease in inactive nodes & a 1.67-fold rise in node energy use relative to traditional methods. The present study suggests a prospective future trajectory for LEACH-based, AI-augmented, low-power IoT infrastructure.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Enhancements in Indian Payment Systems: A Futuristic Perspective on Financial Applications and Modifications
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This study explores the application of machine learning (ML) to improve Indian payment systems, with a focus on AI-driven developments for tasks including fraud detection, transaction validation, and consumer behaviour research. We evaluate the effectiveness of several machine learning (ML) systems, including K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Random Forest (RF), Decision Trees (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Logistic Regression (LR), using a variety of criteria. The results, which include precision, F1 score, accuracy, recall, and AUC, show how well Random Forest and Logistic Regression work to detect fraudulent transactions. Important elements including transaction amount, payment method, and user behaviour patterns are also revealed by the feature importance evaluation. Significant differences exist between models in terms of training times and hyperparameter optimisation outcomes. All things considered, this study highlights how ML models can spur innovation in Indian payment systems, enhancing security, effectiveness, and consumer satisfaction while offering a thorough assessment structure for potential future implementation in the fintech industry.

articleTitle: $k^{\prime}$ -Lucas Sequence for Elliptic Curve Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{k}^{\prime}$</tex> -Lucas sequence is a significant generalization of the classical Lucas sequence, exhibiting various intriguing properties and applications across mathematics and cryptography. The study of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{k}^{\prime}$</tex> -Lucas-like sequences on elliptic curves has gained attention recently, which offer unique structural advantages for cryptographic systems. An extension of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{k}^{\prime}$</tex> -Lucas sequence defined on elliptic curves (EC) is presented in this study, highlighting its recursive nature and algebraic characteristics. Additionally, we suggest an encryption scheme that makes use of this sequence, leveraging the complexities inherent in “Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem (ECDLP)” [1]. Our findings indicate that this approach enhances security and opens new avenues for robust cryptographic protocols.

articleTitle: Convolutional-Neural Network Bases Speaker Emotion Detection Based on Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The present investigation proposes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based method for human-computer interaction (HCI) speaker emotion identification. Optimising the user experience through clearer and sympathetic connections is made possible by emotional knowledge. Conventional techniques for detecting emotions depend on manually created characteristics, which are frequently laborious and less resilient to speech variability. By using CNNs' automatic feature extraction capabilities, the suggested system analyses speech signal spectrograms and extracts crucial emotional indicators. The method obtains notable gains in emotion classification accuracy by retraining the system on a varied collection of emotional speech samples. Important emotional states like happiness, anger, sadness, and neutrality are all successfully distinguished using the CNN model. This study demonstrates how deep learning can help develop emotion-sensitive HCI systems and promote more organic and contextually aware human-machine interactions. Applications in customer service, healthcare, and virtual assistants can benefit from the technique's adaptability and versatility.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Customer Experience: the Impact of AI-Driven Banking Automation
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Automated banking services have changed the way customers interact with banks, making transactions faster, safer, and more convenient. This study looks at how technologies like ATMs, internet banking, and mobile apps impact customer satisfaction. This paper assesses how automated banking services contribute to customer satisfaction, including the pros and cons it poses to customers. The report seeks to understand how these automation technologies as ATMs, internet and mobile banking have served the customer's quest for convenience and service delivery efficiency using automated data collection from past literature, bank reports, and industry articles. The results prioritize the need for efficient, secure, and easy to use automation as a strategy for meeting stand user needs for increased satisfaction. By reviewing reports, industry studies, and research, it highlights the benefits of automation, such as 24/7 access, fewer errors, and greater efficiency. However, some challenges remain, like security risks, digital literacy barriers, and the loss of personal interaction in banking. The study also explores how different groups of people adopt these services and stresses the need for simple, user-friendly banking solutions. As banks continue to innovate, finding the right balance between technology and personal service will be key to keeping customers happy and loyal. This research provides insights into how digital banking is evolving and what it means for the future of customer-friendly financial services.

articleTitle: Investigate the Vulnerabilities and Improvements in Biometric Authentication Systems Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The advances in digitization globally, is essential to have efficient and effective system which would enable a secured data communication. The paradigm shift has led to many critical issues which has an impact on the performance of the system. Biometrics is one of the technologies to enhance authentication and security of the information technology systems. The biometric authentication systems have gained widespread adoption in various domains due to their potential to enhance security and user convenience. However, these systems are immune to vulnerabilities, understanding and addressing these weaknesses are crucial for ensuring the reliability of biometric authentication. The biometric technology has to ensure high security and reliability. In the current scenario the biometric verification and validation methods comprises of finger print recognition, iris scanning, facial recognition, voice recognition and other sophisticated approaches. The research focuses on the study and analysis of security vulnerabilities of the biometric technology. The vulnerabilities result in inaccurately identification or failure of identification of the individuals. This contribution focuses on to enhance the performance of the biometric system, we propose a multimodal biometric approach to enable secured and efficient system. Here we propose two approaches which can be applied to validate a biometric system. the fingerprint authentication and Iris scanning using the deep learning technology.

articleTitle: A Review on Feature Selection Techniques for Anxiety Classification from Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Anxiety disorders significantly impact individuals' quality of life and are traditionally assessed using subjective methods, which often lack accuracy. Recent advancements have enabled the use of physiological signals for anxiety classification, providing a more objective approach. However, the multidomain nature of these signals results in high-dimensional feature sets, necessitating effective feature selection. Therefore, this paper reviews various feature selection techniques-filter, wrapper, embedded, and hybrid-used in physiological-based anxiety classification, analyzing the advantages and limitations. It also highlights key challenges and suggests future research directions. Furthermore, this review introduces a proposed study utilizing a novel Corr-FGA hybrid feature selection algorithm to develop an efficient anxiety classification framework. The proposed framework achieves the highest accuracy of 88.93% using 8 features. This review aims to guide researchers in developing a robust, efficient anxiety classification model while providing insights that can help streamline feature selection and optimize machine learning model performance in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Two-Step Random Forest Classification with L1 Regularization Feature Selection for IoT Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The increasing number of IoT devices raises the risk of cyberattacks on these devices. IoT devices are frequently equipped with weak security measures, making them susceptible to various malware, including spyware, ransomware, and trojans. Many existing studies primarily differentiate between benign and malicious networks, but they often overlook the importance of identifying specific types of malware. Recognizing the type of malware can significantly aid in making informed incident-handling decisions. Considering these risks, this study introduces an innovative two-step framework designed to not only detect potential attacks but also to pinpoint the specific type of malware involved. The initial step involves differentiating between benign and malicious network traffic, while the subsequent step identifies the specific type of malware, such as spyware, ransomware, or trojan. Both steps employ the Random Forest algorithm for classification. Furthermore, the Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (L1 Regularization) method is utilized for feature selection during the training process, aimed at enhancing model performance. This research utilizes the CIC-MaIMem dataset, which captures malware attacks within IoT networks. From the experiment, it is found that the proposed model has better results than the one-step multiclass Random Forest model. Performance evaluation of the proposed model obtained an accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${8 7. 2 4 {\%}}$</tex>, precision of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${8 0. 7 9 {\%}}$</tex>, recall of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${8 0. 8 1 {\%}}$</tex>, and F1-score of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${8 0. 7 9 {\%}}$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact of GDPR on Data Protection in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Data regulators must completely adhere to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). To comply with their duties within GDPR and the conditions established with the data topic, regulators must ensure that all statistics streams from the data area to controlling devices, processing units, and sub-processors (such as., the data supply network) satisfy these requirements. Using a two-pronged investigation, this work aims to help connect both sides of legal verification. Initially, this study provides a structure for implementing a document-based method for supply network data protection verification. Secondly, this study provides certain techniques to automatically verify that privacy regulations are being followed. This study evaluated a system with two components. The initial component uses natural language processing (NLP) to gather data standards from confidentiality rules. The GDPR is encoded in the 2nd component to verify that all required data is there. The outcomes demonstrate that the text-to-text method functions better than regional classification algorithms and allows for the collection of both thin-grained and coarse-grained statistics using a single system. This study tests the framework thoroughly using a database of thirty confidentiality agreements that have been tagged by regulatory professionals. This study implies that this strategy might be used in other documentation in the data stream to enhance whole adherence.

articleTitle: Standardized Post-Quantum Cryptography and Recent Developments in Quantum Computers
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Traditional cryptographic frameworks are seriously threatened by the quick development of quantum computing, especially those that depend on public-key cryptosystems like RSA and ECC. Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) seeks to create cryptographic methods that are impervious to quantum computer assaults in order to overcome this difficulty. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), which has selected and standardised quantum-resistant techniques like CRYSTALS-Kyber for key encapsulation and CRYSTALS-Dilithium for digital signatures, has sparked recent advancements in PQC. At the same time, the need for reliable PQC solutions has increased due to developments in quantum computing, such as IBM's improvements in qubit stability and Google's “quantum supremacy” assertion. In order to protect data security in the post-quantum age, PQC regulations must be adopted globally, as highlighted by the intersection of these fields. Current developments in PQC standardisation and the changing state of quantum computing technology are highlighted in this paper.

articleTitle: Media Access Techniques for Efficient Channel Utilization in SATCOM Interactive Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Media access protocols are the core of the low-level network architecture of communications systems and play a pivotal role in the efficient utilization of shared media. Media access protocols are designed to coordinate the transmission and to reduce the collision over the shared media, and they govern efficient access and improved quality of service. In the wireless domain, bandwidth has always been a critical resource and must be utilized efficiently. Media access protocol helps to manage the access of the media to meet the service requirements. Protocols are intended to provide high channel throughput and low transmission delay. In this paper, we present the techniques employed by media access protocols, classification approach, impact of the network parameters, and protocol suitability as per the service requirement. The comparative outline of the protocols has also been presented. This paper provides a comprehensive and systematic analysis of the MAC protocols for satellite communication that will be useful in selecting suitable protocols in real-life communication systems.

articleTitle: Advancing Solar Energy Through Artificial Intelligence: A Focus on Optimization and Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: As the need for sustainable and clean energy solutions grows, solar energy systems are becoming an increasingly important part of the solution to the world's climate problems. However, operational uncertainty and environmental unpredictability have a major impact on photovoltaic (PV) system efficiency. With an emphasis on energy forecasts, real-time changes, and system performance enhancements, this study investigates the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) for solar energy system optimization. To forecast energy generation, maximize energy storage, and improve operational efficiency, artificial intelligence (AI) approaches like Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and hybrid AI models are used. Through AI-integrated numerical weather forecasting, the suggested AI-embedded solar energy framework reduces absolute forecasting error by 51.7%, hourly prediction variations by 9-20%, and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by 18-20%. IoT-enabled real-time monitoring systems and cloud-based artificial intelligence platforms allow for dynamic energy modifications in response to variations in power generation and demand. The findings show notable advancements in cost reduction, energy balancing, and predictive maintenance, guaranteeing sustainable energy supply. Additionally, forecasting powered by AI improves grid dependability and makes it easier to integrate dispersed energy sources. This study demonstrates AI's revolutionary potential to improve PV system efficiency, lower transmission losses, and lower energy expenses. Future research highlights how crucial it is to overcome privacy issues, data standardization, and ethical considerations in order to achieve broad use of AI technologies in renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Smart Manufacturing: Integrating IoT and AI for Agile Production Management
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Production management is being revolutionised by smart manufacturing, which is fuelled by the combination of artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT) and allows for quick, data-driven decision-making. Through this interface, producers may use cutting-edge machine learning models and real-time sensor data for process optimisation, quality assurance, and predictive maintenance. Model performance is evaluated using evaluation metrics like accuracy, recall, ROC curves, and AUC in conjunction with machine learning approaches including classification, regression, and time series forecasting. AI-driven systems can enhance production scheduling, anticipate equipment problems, and optimise resource allocation by utilising IoT data. This makes it possible to create agile manufacturing environments that can minimise downtime and react swiftly to changes in demand. The robustness and dependability of these AI models are further improved by the addition of machine learning assessment techniques including learning curves, feature importance, and cross-validation. In the end, this IoT and AI synergy enables manufacturers to attain increased productivity, cost reductions, and adaptability in dynamic production environments.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Driven Cloud Intrusion Detection: Internet of Things and Cloud Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In this paper, we have utilized deep learning approaches to detect cloud intrusion for the Internet of Things (IoT). The emerging growth of IoT and cloud environments has revolutionized many industries by allowing real-time data sharing and storage. Cloud platforms offer the essential infrastructure for managing the massive volumes of data produced by IoT devices. However, due to several flaws, including insufficient encryption, insecure APIs, and weak authentication, intruders can exploit the vulnerabilities to interrupt services and obtain unauthorized access. Therefore, deep learning can be an effective solution to detect cloud intrusion in IoT. In this research, we have developed individual convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) models, along with a hybrid CNN-LSTM model for multiclass classification and binary classification to detect cloud intrusion. In addition, we have examined which models perform the best for cloud intrusion detection for IoT among the individual and hybrid models. The proposed models are effective in detecting cloud intrusion, as CNN can extract spatial features, and LSTM can capture temporal dependencies from network traffic data. Furthermore, we have utilized one of the most recent and comprehensive datasets for IoT, the ToN-IoT dataset, containing real-world data. In multiclass classification, the hybrid CNN-LSTM has given the best performance, achieving an accuracy of 97.65%, precision of 97.72%, recall of 97.65%, f1 score of 97.67%, and AUC of 99.93%. In binary classification, all CNN, LSTM, and hybrid CNN-LSTM have demonstrated high performance, where LSTM has achieved the highest accuracy of 99.97%. Moreover, we have evaluated the performance of multiclass classification for detecting nine distinct kinds of attacks. In this instance, CNN has shown better performance in detecting backdoor attacks. Thus, this research can make the IoT platform more secure by efficiently detecting cloud intrusion.

articleTitle: Enhancing Academic Feedback Systems with Deep Learning and Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This paper attempts to improve the academic feedback systems via complex deep learning and ensemble methods. Leveraging the NIRF Rankings 2022 dataset that provides radical performance metrics of Indian academic institutions, the project would attempt to develop trustworthy models to monitor and facilitate improvement in the academic feedback system. The techniques used in data preparation prevent missing values, outliers, and categorical data in using advanced machine learning models. In order to construct the model and capture fine-grained patterns linked to academic achievement, 1D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) along with Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs), both individually and in combination, are employed extrapolated from the National Institutional Ranking Framework to obtain data. Precision, accuracy, recall, along with the F1-score will be used to evaluate these models' performance. By the time these findings are finished, they should be able to provide practical advice on how to improve academic evaluations' effectiveness and advance educational institutions' more flexible feedback systems.

articleTitle: Blockchain Applications in Supply Chain Management: Enhancing Transparency and Traceability
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) may be used by conventional transparency and traceability platforms, however, they often lack transparency and traceability across the whole manufacturing procedure. Furthermore, it may be difficult to ensure the openness of goods statistics needed for traceability from their origin when there are fraudulent partners, which could pose safety threats to these transparency and traceability structures. The blockchain platform receives the gathered statistics and uses them for processing, storing, and querying. The safety of the statistics accessing the network can be guaranteed by a dispersed, decentralized, and unchangeable blockchain. Nevertheless, during the data-gathering procedure, IoT gadgets could provide unusual statistics. The accuracy of the transparency and traceability structure's input statistics must be guaranteed in this situation. This article examines the data of a crop supply chain from cultivating to earnings, builds the layout and every operation, and develops and deploys a machine learning (ML-)-based blockchain-IoT-oriented crop transparency and traceability framework (MBICTTS) with consideration for the transparency and traceability chain of crop-based goods. This paper suggests a novel approach that blends blockchain with ML to improve the performance of blockchain resource statistics, like IoT -like radio frequency recognition (RFID) detectors. Furthermore, scanning and restoration techniques, sorting strategies, and platform data storage are suggested. The implementation of the ML data validation process can guarantee the accuracy (99<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) of the data on the network in contrast to the current blockchain-based crop transparency and traceability platform. The suggested fix offers a foundation for guaranteeing the effectiveness, dependability, and security of crop traceability platforms.

articleTitle: Examining the Influence of Technological Advancements on Trade Strategies & Consumer Behavior in the Progression of Electronic Commerce and Omnichannel Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The fast progress of electronic commerce has revolutionized businesses, restructured business tactics and changed consumer activities globally. This paper observes the impact of generation on business tactics and client actions inside the situation of electronic commerce advancement, with selected cognizance on omnichannel processes. utilizing complete exploration of present literature, it investigates the numerous technological improvements that have molded e-trade landscape & changed the manner shops interact with customers. evaluation starts through tracking the historic improvement of electronic trade, from early beginnings in 1990s to cutting-edge, emphasizing key changes and inventions which have boosted its progress then explores the transformative function of generation in permitting outlets to improve their actions, and attain new marketplaces through omnichannel integration. it examines the effect of technologies together with AI(artificial intelligence), big facts analytics and cellular trade on business techniques, emphasizing their inferences for rating, product variety, marketing, & customer support throughout multiple channels. It also studies the effect of era on business techniques on buyer conduct in the context of omnichannel retailing. The evaluation concludes by way of reviewing the results of electronic commerce development for stores, customers, and the precise business environment within the context of omnichannel retailing. Also, investigates the results for customers, together with the developing importance of belief, comfort, and personalization in shaping purchasing choices across numerous channels and thematic analysis is also conducted. Overall, this paper offers valuable visions into the transformative effect of era on business techniques and patron conduct inside the generation of electronic commerce evolution, emphasizing the critical position of omnichannel integration in riding sustainable growth in the years to come.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Performance Monitoring for Saas Applications in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: As SaaS applications in the cloud continue to flourish, effective application performance monitoring and management solutions have become a necessity. AI technology provides a significant, effective solution to this problem by implementing an extensive, on-time execution monitoring system that can comprehend the SaaS applications' acting circumstances. This AI-enhanced performance Monitoring for SaaS Applications in the Cloud is an advanced solution that leverages machine learning and artificial intelligence methods to monitor and enhance the performance of SaaS applications. It's trained to receive and analyze extensive data from constant interaction with users, as well as the metrics of servers and the traffic from the network. The algorithms then use that data to spot patterns and anomalies, predict performance issues before they occur, and automatically take proactive steps to optimize application performance. The system is constantly learning and continues to adapt to changing conditions, which allows it to detect and resolve issues quickly, ensuring maximum user experience and minimal disruption to business. AI-enhanced performance Monitoring system also provides detailed insights and analytics to help make better decisions and allocate resources efficiently. This solution allows companies to ensure their SaaS apps continue to work at an optimal level so that users remain happy, operations are efficient, and the company is able to succeed.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Artificial Intelligence and Business Intelligence Using Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Business intelligence (BI) encompasses the tools and uses to gather, combine, examine, and display data about a specific firm. Using historical and current efficiency comparisons, these structures assist in formulating plans and choices to achieve better outcomes in the future. Additionally, it helps firms determine which business issues and industry trends require attention. It has several benefits, such as increasing responsibility and efficiency, but it carries some disadvantages, such as being expensive, complicated, and time-consuming to adopt. Using big data-driven approaches to optimize talent recruitment is essential for improved decisions in the cutthroat world of BI. The efficacy of many machine learning algorithms to increase recruiting performance and accuracy is compared in this investigation. For optimizing, cross-validating, and hyperparameter modification were employed. The Random Forest (RF) algorithm has the greatest accuracy (92.9%), trailed by the Gradient Boosting Classifying system (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{92.6 \%}$</tex>) and the neural network (NNs) models (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${92}.7 \%$</tex>). These findings imply that sophisticated ML algorithms, in particular RF and NN, can greatly improve BI platforms' hiring procedures. Recruiters can benefit from this research's insightful recommendations for incorporating advanced ML methods into talent recruitment plans.

articleTitle: Role of Quantum Cryptography in Securing Communication Channels in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0, which is characterised by networked systems, Internet of Things devices, and cyber-physical networks, quantum cryptography is essential to strengthening communication channels. In contrast to traditional cryptography techniques, quantum cryptography uses quantum physics concepts, notably quantum key distribution (QKD), to provide unmatched security. By taking advantage of the quantum property of superposition and measurement-induced disruption, QKD offers tamper-evident key exchanges, protecting data from efforts at eavesdropping. This guarantees that any communication interception causes system disruption and warns users of possible dangers. Quantum cryptography reduces the risks associated with traditional encryption techniques in Industry 4.0, as sensitive data moves across automated systems, smart factories, and decentralised supply chains. This is especially true as quantum computing advances. Industries can attain strong data integrity, confidentiality, and resistance against new cyberthreats by incorporating quantum-secured channels, opening the door for a dependable and safe digital transformation. This presentation highlights how quantum cryptography is revolutionising the security paradigms of Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Employee Retention Analysis: Insights and Predictive Modeling With Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Brain tumors are one of the most serious and potentially fatal diseases in the world, to have any hope of being successfully treated it is imperative that they be discovered early. Conventional diagnostic methods such as MRI and CT images often rely on manual interpretation; this can take a long time and is prone to human error. To address this situation, we present a deep learning-based approach which uses a Deep Convolutional Neural Network for automatic detection of brain tumors. The resultant model takes advantage of the powerful feature extraction abilities of CNNs in order to divide brain images into tumor and non-tumor categories with high precision. The dataset consists of MRI scans and has been preprocessed to enhance image quality while removing noise. Employing advanced techniques such as data augmentation, transfer learning and hyperparameter tuning, the structure of this CNN network for brain tumor detection is optimized. Experimental results prove that the combination is superior to traditional machine learning methods. In medical imaging, this research shows that the potential for deep learning is enormous and will help pave the way for easier, accurate brain tumor detection systems.

Author Keywords: Medical Imaging and Convolutional Neural Network

articleTitle: Development of Real-Time Oxygen and Temperature Monitoring System with CI/CD Pipeline Integration and HMI
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The steel manufacturing industry stands as the backbone of global infrastructure development, providing the raw materials essential for constructing everything from skyscrapers to automobiles. Central to this industry's efficiency is the performance of its furnaces, where the transformation of raw materials into high-quality steel occurs. Steel furnace environments require precise monitoring of parameters like temperature and oxygen levels to ensure efficiency, safety, and compliance with environmental standards. This paper presents a novel monitoring device designed to address these needs while incorporating modern software development practices. The device offers real-time monitoring and graph visualization of temperature and oxygen levels, surpassing conventional methods. It introduces the integration of Git, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and diagnostic tools, enhancing reliability and facilitating seamless updates. This amalgamation of hardware and software engineering replaces outdated monitoring systems. Through its multifaceted capabilities, this research contributes significantly to the evolution of smart, interconnected industrial systems, promising improved performance and safety in steel furnace operations. The NXP LPC 55s69 micro-controller unit is used for the computation of oxygen and temperature from a zirconia-based oxygen sensor and thermocouple using nernst-einstein equation. For integration of the device with a PLC control we have used RS232 and RS485 communication protocols.

articleTitle: Increased Technical Efficiency of Various Renewable Energy Resources in Smart Grids and Power System
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The smart grid (SG) idea was created to give the power lattice the elements and abilities it requirements to effectively integrate environmentally renewable energy sources (RES) and achieve versatility. Since energy sources like sun oriented and wind power are innately unstable and unusual, controlling in shrewd organizations can be troublesome. This study proposes an original answer for this issue by combining the upsides of particle swarm optimisation (PSO) and extreme learning machine (ELM) approaches. The proposed approach models and conjectures sustainable power age utilizing ELM, taking into account more exact preparation and determining. PSO guarantees maximized execution and effectiveness by improving the ELM calculation's boundaries in the meantime. Using a dataset of sun based energy yield, this study surveyed the proposed procedure and stood out its outcomes from those of other improvement techniques. The findings demonstrate that our ELM-PSO method lowers energy costs in smart grids and greatly increases the accuracy of predictions for renewable energy. Because the proposed approach can be employed to a range of RS sources, including hydroelectric power plants, wind turbines and solar panels, this investigation has wide-ranging implications. It can build a more robust and sustainable energy future by increasing the effectiveness and dependability of using renewable energy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Hybrid System with Bidirectional Energy Flow in PEMFC Powered BLDCM Drive and Batteries
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The promise of increased efficiency and dependability has drawn much attention to hybrid energy systems combining several energy sources. This study suggests integrating a fuel cell, a battery system through a bidirectional converter (BDC), and a brushless DC (BLDC) motor for electric vehicle applications. The battery system functions as a buffer, storing extra energy and supplying power during periods of high demand or sporadic circumstances, while the fuel cell (FC) serves as the main power source, generating energy continuously. A BDC effectively manages power flow between the fuel cell, battery, and load, allowing a smooth transition between charging and discharging modes. A BLDC motor is also used for mechanical work or propulsion since it is extremely efficient, requires little maintenance, and has accurate speed control. By combining these elements, a flexible hybrid energy system can be created that maximizes energy efficiency, improves system resilience, and has a smaller overall environmental effect. This work highlights the potential of the suggested system for multiple applications in both fixed and mobile environments by discussing its design considerations, control methodologies, and performance analysis. The integrated FC, battery, BDC, and BLDC motor systems are both effective and feasible through simulation results; this has opened the door for creating sustainable and efficient energy solutions for the modern world. The circuit is simulated on MATLAB Simulink software and the results are discussed.

articleTitle: NMT Framework for Verse Translation from Hindi to English with CDEC
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In the modern era, AI and ML are highly demanding Technologies. AI and ML are used to train machines and computers to do types of human work or exactly like human beings. articleTitle: Optimizing Household Energy Consumption: A Web-Based Tool for Real-Time Carbon Footprint Calculation and Sustainable Benchmarking
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This is an innovative project from an energy-saving perspective. This project ensures that users become in control of their energy consumption and able to take an actively reducing their carbon footprints. It provides users with an interface to input details about household appliances and usage patterns, through which a correct calculation of the carbon footprint could be done. Compared against standard norms, it would help the users identify certain areas where improvement is possible and adopt more sustainable use of energy. Apart from personalized energy assessments, it has now become the central source that connects users to local schemes and initiatives on sustainable energy, including information on resources and programs into waste energy and carbon emission reduction. This integration, therefore, promotes more engagement and involvement within the community as users are nudged to join in the efforts that are being made for the goal of energy conservation. The platform educates its users about energy consumption and aids them in making green choices in data; however, with a holistic approach in carbon footprint management and education pertaining to sustainable long-term behavior, the process takes place through integrated accurate energy tracking, fine recommendations, and community-driven action.

articleTitle: Estimation of Response Time with Neural Networks in Cloud Computing System
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Resource allotment, responsiveness, connection, research of unexplored assets, related resource modeling, and asset scheduling are just a few of the numerous factors and concerns that need to be considered to enhance cloud computing efficiency. The functionality of the cloud has a significant impact on the propagation of cloud architecture. Consequently, it is important to determine the components that influence cloud function to analyze it. Response duration is the primary aspect that significantly affects cloud computation functioning, according to the research. The response duration assistance is among the numerous different variables that may be used to organize resource applications. Artificial neural networks (ANNs) were employed as a technique for evaluating the parameter of pursuit, and a fork-join framework or an architecture with demand partitioning was selected as the queuing paradigm. As a result, this study suggests a load-managing method depending on cloud demand response duration using the ARIMA Estimation of Response Duration Method. The fundamental concept is to employ ARIMA methods to estimate the future response duration, providing a more efficient method of allocating resources with limited values. The results of the investigation demonstrated that the estimations were more precise compared to those that had been recently established. The results of the study indicate that estimation is an outstanding path for load balance and has possibility and value for load balance with displayed response duration. Additionally, the suggested method makes it feasible to acquire estimations for a wider range of cloud structure functioning signs compared to earlier feasible and also to extend the evaluation of the cloud platform to the instance of a structure with a non-Poisson data flow and non-exponential assistance duration.

articleTitle: Balancing Environmental Sustainability and Technological Innovation in 6G Wireless Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Unprecedented improvements in connectivity, speed, and latency are anticipated with the emergence of 6G wireless technology, opening the door for game-changing applications like AI-driven automation, smart cities, and holographic communications. Nevertheless, there are serious environmental consequences associated with these breakthroughs, such as resource destruction, elevated energy use, and electrical waste. It takes a comprehensive strategy that incorporates energy-efficient hardware, sustainable software, and green design concepts to strike a balance between technological innovation and environmental sustainability in 6G. Low-power network topologies, energy-harvesting technology, and the use of renewable energy sources are examples of emerging tactics. Furthermore, reducing the environmental impact of 6G architecture requires the adoption of circular economy principles like recycling devices and using eco-friendly materials. To ensure sustainable development, industry rules, policy structures, and cross-sector partnerships will be essential. In order to provide understanding of design considerations, problems, and future perspectives for a greener wireless future, this study examines the combined quest of technological excellence and environmental responsibility in 6G.

articleTitle: Camera-Based Misalignment Detection and Hardware Validation for EV Wireless Charging Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This paper addresses misalignment issues in wireless EV charging, which most of the time results in a non-ideal alignment of the vehicle with the charging pad, thus introducing inefficiencies in power transfer. A careful analysis conducts a detailed study regarding the effects of misalignment on coil voltage, current, and power using a distance-dependent prototype. Real-time positional differences are identified and analyzed using an AI-based alignment correction module implemented with OpenCV, which provides precise measurements of misalignment along the x and y axes. These insights help optimize alignment to enhance system efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that even small improvements in alignment significantly boost power transfer efficiency, emphasizing the importance of accurate positioning. Validating the potential of the prototype in improving charging efficiency under varying alignment conditions makes the research findings sensible.

articleTitle: Enhancing Software Bug Prediction with Extreme Learning Machine: An Empirical Analysis Using NASA Datasets
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Predicting software bugs before development cycles allows developers to mitigate potential issues before they escalate into significant problems. This paper presents a novel hybrid approach for Software Bug Prediction (SBP), integrating Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) for dimensionality reduction with an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) classifier. The outlined scheme significantly enhances prediction accuracy by using PCA to minimize the feature space while maintaining 95% of the variance and LDA to optimize class separability. Tested on high-dimensional datasets, the model achieved a remarkable accuracy of 98.49% on the MC1 dataset, outperforming other leading models in the field. The results underscore the effectiveness of the PCA+LDA+ELM combination in capturing complex patterns in software bug data, leading to more accurate predictions. Furthermore, high scores in the recall, F1, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) metrics demonstrate the model's robustness and applicability in real-world software engineering environments. This hybrid technique offers a reliable and efficient solution for improving software quality through early defect prediction.

articleTitle: Document Summariser & Questiongenerator Using LLMS
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)

authors.preferredName: D M V S V Karthik Jayanthi

abstract: Extracting meaningful insights from PDF documents is a challenging task due to their extensive content. This study presents a novel Document Summarizer & Question Generator that integrates state-of-the-art NLP models-FLAN T5 for summarization and GPT-3.5-turbo for question generation. Our approach achieves competitive performance, as validated through ROUGE metrics. A user-friendly web interface built with Streamlit enables seamless document processing. Comparative evaluation demonstrates that FLAN T5-DialogSum outperforms other summarization models, while GPT-3.5-turbo excels in generating contextually relevant questions. This tool enhances document comprehension across academic, legal, and corporate domains.

articleTitle: Random Security Generators with Enhanced Cryptography for Cybersecurity in Financial Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Blockchains, like Ethereum, depend on a distributed system of collaborative servers referred to as inspectors or mine workers to validate transactions and generate novel legal blocks. In today's electronic world, it is critical to secure financial supply chains (FSCs) from complex cyber-attacks. This study combines Quantized Random Security Generators (QRSGs) with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve cybersecurity in FSC. QRSGs use quantum physics to produce random outcomes, which is critical for establishing safe cryptography credentials and resolving the flaws of regular predictable RSGs. This study found that the QRSG-based approach outperformed traditional RSG methods. The QRSG demonstrated strong entropy and uncertainty, transferring both NIST SP800-22 and Diehard examinations at much greater levels. The platform's real-time safety features were improved by the AI element's outstanding performance measures in identifying security breaches. More rapid decoding and encryption times, reduced delay, and increased resilience to brute-force, quantum, and prediction assaults were all demonstrated by the coupled QRSG and AI methods. This study emphasizes how crucial it is to use AI and QRSGs to safeguard FSCs. The combined platform provides a complete option to reduce cyber-attacks by offering strong cryptography security and real-time attack identification. These results demonstrate how QRSG and AI innovations can completely transform cybersecurity in the banking industry, safeguarding vital financial systems and guaranteeing the privacy and reliability of financial payments.
