articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach Using Cryptography and K-Least Significant Bit Steganography Algorithm in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The exponential growth of communication technologies has broadened the cloud computing ecosystem horizon to meet main communication needs. However, in-parallel upsurge in online attacks has alarmed industries to ensure optimal data security. The combination of steganography and cryptosystems has been recognized as an enhanced security model for data transfer among the main security systems now in use. In this paper, a hybrid approach using cryptography and K- Least Significant Bit Steganography algorithm in Cloud Computing (HYBC-KLSBS-CC) are proposed. Initially, input text data is retrieved from cloud storage and compressed using Huffman Compression Coding (HCC) to reduce data size. The compressed data is then encrypted with a Hybrid Cryptography Algorithm (Hyb-MRFC-ALC), combining Modified Random Fibonacci Cryptography and Asymmetric Lightweight Cryptography to ensure robust encryption. Finally, encrypted data is embedded within an image using the K-Least Significant Bit (KLSB) steganography technique, providing additional layer of security. The proposed method enhances data confidentiality, integrity, and storage efficiency in cloud environments. The proposed HYBC-KLSBS-CC approach attains 26.89%, 29.49% and 18.64% lower PSNR and 26.89%, 29.49% and 18.64% lower MSE when analyzed through existing techniques like data security dependent on cryptography steganography related with OTP procedure and Huffman coding in the cloud environment (CS-OTP-CE), a novel hybrid cryptographic framework for secure data storage in cloud computing: Integrating AES-OTP and RSA with adaptive key management and Time-Limited access control (AES-OTP-RSA-CC) and Crypto-Stegno dependent model for securing medical information on IOMT platform (CS-SMI-IOMT).

articleTitle: Analysing Effectiveness of Artificial Intelligence on Indian Judicial System
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology has been widely used in the legal system in recent years. Compared to human judges, artificial intelligence is more unbiased, competent, and efficient when used for judicial purposes. Mostly relying on huge data, algorithms, and processing power instead of natural intelligence, it has drawbacks. Artificial intelligence in the judiciary cannot fully replace human judges due to disparities in theoretical framework, application circumstances, and potential and ability. Declaring unequivocally that human judges will always be replaced by judicial artificial intelligence is essential. Investigating legal concerns and the several ways AI affects the judicial system is the goal of the study. Predicting a legal system's conclusion became feasible with the advent of artificial intelligence and related technologies. This study's objective is to provide the most precise legal case prediction possible. Furthermore, because of advances in machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and processing capacity, these data offer significant opportunities to employ machine-learning models to evaluate and improve judicial systems. DT achieved the lowest accuracy percentage, while KNN achieved the best at 72%.

articleTitle: Developing a Blockchain-Based AI-IoT Platform for Industrial Automation and Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Blockchain, artificial intelligence (AI), and the internet of things (IoT) come together to offer a transformative opportunity to increase automation, effectiveness, and security across a variety of industries. Blockchain ensures decentralised trust, data integrity, and safe transactions, while AI enables analytics in real time, predictive insights, and intelligent decision-making. IoT enables smooth communication among the digital and physical worlds by connecting and gathering enormous volumes of data from smart devices. By combining these innovations, a synergistic ecosystem is produced in which AI safely analyses data provided by the Internet of Things and stores it on blockchain networks, guaranteeing transparency and immutability. Smart cities, healthcare, supply chain management, and autonomous systems are just a few of the many fields where this incorporation can be used to promote innovation and operational resilience. To fully utilise this trinity, however, issues like flexibility, compatibility, and privacy concerns need to be resolved. This study examines the advantages, drawbacks, and potential avenues for further research of the synergy amongst blockchain, AI, and the IoT.

articleTitle: Enhancing Malicious URL Detection with Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Malicious URLs pose a significant threat to online security. The can steal our personal information and can even hack out system. Refraining ourselves from using such malicious websites is the need of the hour. This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of various machine learning algorithms which are used to effectively detect and mitigate these threats. This research explores the performance of traditional machine learning techniques including Random Forests,Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, as well as advanced techniques like XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost while the previous works focused on only traditional classification techniques. Additionally, this work investigates the potential of deep learning models, including LSTM and CNN, to capture intricate patterns within URL sequences. Machine learning algorithms are evaluated using the evaluations metrics including Accuracy, Recall, Precision and F1 score. Experimental Results and analysis have shown that advanced models outperform traditional classification techniques. These results valuable insights into the most effective approaches for safeguarding online users from malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Integration of Process Optimization and Automation: A Way to AI Powered Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: One of the most important factors facilitating AI-powered digital transformation is the combination of process automation and optimisation. Organisations may improve operational efficacy, save costs, and streamline procedures by utilising cutting-edge technology like robotic process automation (RPA), machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI). While automation seeks to reduce human participation in repetitive and rule-based operations, process optimisation concentrates on improving current business processes to attain improved productivity. The development of intelligent, adaptable, and self-improving systems is made possible by the combination of these two methodologies. Predictive findings, real-time decision-making, and customised customer experiences are further made possible by AI-driven analytics. This connection promotes innovation, scalability, and agility across sectors, giving businesses a competitive edge in the quickly changing digital market. The article examines the main principles, advantages, and difficulties of this shift and provides a road map for businesses looking to automate and optimise processes using AI in order to attain operational excellence and sustainable growth.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality-Based Patient Tracking in Autonomous Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) integration into autonomous healthcare systems has resulted in dramatic improvements for patient monitoring practices. An AR-based patient tracking system employing wearable devices with augmented reality technology delivers real-time data visualization including vital signs together with medical history and treatments plans to healthcare providers. A combined network of IoT sensors with LSTM technology analyzes time-series data to accurately detect abnormal health patterns in patients' metrics through automated continuous data collection. Through the AR interface healthcare professionals experience enhanced situational awareness by gaining access to an intuitive interactive visual display. The research obtains its data from recognized sources MIMIC-IV and PhysioNet which provide an extensive range of patient information including heart rate and oxygen saturation levels and body temperature values. The datasets received preprocessing and augmentation methods that generated varied healthcare examples for clinical medical departments and remote environments. The evaluation system relies on three key performance metrics that measure response time performance and detection accuracy and resource efficiency. The experimental findings show how the AR-based system det ects critical health events with 92% accuracy while it cuts down response time by 85% exceeding standard monitoring techniques. During emergencies the AR interface enables healthcare professionals to make better decisions by providing them with interactive visual data that improves their situational awareness.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Literary Analysis: Exploring Machine Learning Techniques for Understanding English Literary Texts
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Translating and analyzing literary works in English literary texts, or the other way around, is known as cross-language research in English literature. This multifaceted task involves several elements, such as literary comprehension, cultural adaption, and linguistics conversion. People from a variety of language origins may study and enjoy the depth of English literature by using cross-language examinationto make literary texts initially published in English more widely available. This study presents a novel artificial intelligence (AI) paradigm for examining contemporary English literature poetries, which aligns with the worldwide Sustainable Growth Objectives and interdisciplinary methods fusing AI and sustainability. It goes beyond conventional subjective evaluations by using feature extraction and machine-learning methods to categorize poetry. The system's accuracy and generalization will be improved by extending its application to a wider range of literary forms and approaches. Furthermore, initiatives will concentrate on equitably implementing AI tools to provide access to high-quality learning. This study sheds light on the way AI might improve poetry instruction and support environmental objectives. It paves the way for significant advancements in electronic literature poetry and academic innovation by resolving the noted drawbacks and incorporating the approach into learning environments.

articleTitle: Optimization and Deployment of Joint Source-Channel Coding for Enhance Future 6G Network Performance
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Research on semantic communication has advanced because of deep learning in the construction for collaborative (joint) resource-channel coding (JSCC) project. Deep learning technology (DL)-based JSCC systems currently in practice are developed based upon a preset signal-to-noise ratio (SNR); though, such design is not intended in situations when SNR is changing. Thus, new semantic adaptive system with the semantic adaption modal selectioning (SAMS) modules is developed for semantic communication (SC). It is named collaborative (joint) resource-channel coding with adaptive models (AMJSCC). Both the real-time channel circumstances as well as the model's computing capabilities are taken into account by collaborative (joint) resource-channel encoding (JSCE) & collaborative (joint) resource-channel decoding (JSCD) models. In order to further increase the precision of information recovery, residual networks with various layers are also being studied. Simulation findings show that the model is flexible with the SNR as well as communication services, and it can achieve increased recovery similarity. Meanwhile, it uses less store space and communication resources than the most advanced deep JSCC techniques.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Test Automation for Big Data Systems in Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: AI-based Test Automation for Cloud-Based Big Advanced Data Systems this method used AI and other new data science methods such as big data, cloud computing, etc. Current testing methodologies do not suit the environments of modern big data systems in a cloud-based environment. AI based test automation approaches: Automated test scenario preparation, examination of test events to identify defects and generation of testing issues. Big data systems, on the other hand, can periodically scan for maximum performance with an all-AI approach, carry out A/B testing, and fine-tune performance. This is particularly important for cloud environments when the architecture of the system and data processing continually changes at a high rate. Additionally, AI in test automation is capable of detecting anomalies and predicting possible system breakdown, providing early warning of issues to ensure mitigation and thereby avoiding costly downtime. This way various scenarios and data sets can be tested and covered to ensure that the best results are covered.

articleTitle: A Survey of Federated Learning Orchestration Using Kubeflow: Challenges, Advances, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In distributed machine learning, Federated Learning (FL) has become a game-changing paradigm that allows for cooperative model training while protecting data privacy and taking regulatory compliance into account and with a focus on edge computing integration and privacy protection techniques. This paper offers a systematic assessment of federated learning orchestration using Kubeflow, looking at architectural approaches and implementation issues in Kubernetes-native contexts and includes thorough technical evaluation and code-driven solutions, identifies a number of crucial implementation challenges for Federated Learning processes, such as edge gateway service design, dynamic device management, and adaptive privacy methods. We explore exciting research avenues like context-aware federation protocols, adaptive privacy mechanisms, and dynamic privacy preservation. We also point out important research gaps in existing implementations, particularly with regard to standardized performance metrics, sophisticated fault tolerance mechanisms, and machine learning-optimized orchestration strategies. For researchers and practitioners working on Kubeflow-based federated learning deployments, this paper offers conceptual examples for managing heterogeneous device capabilities, secure model exchange, and adaptive training configurations in Kubeflow-based FL systems highlighting important areas that need further research for enterprise-grade implementations.

articleTitle: AccessArc: Transforming Digital Accessibility Through Secure AI-Powered Inclusive Design and Unified Service Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: AccessArc is a progressive application that enhances accessibility for the differently abled through a centralized platform that connects with government schemes and employment options. It addresses the fragmentation of information, inaccessibility, and unawareness by consolidating resources into one accessible interface. It provides machine learning-based recommendations, voice navigation, and facial recognition login to ensure accessibility with ease. The customizable user interface enables the changes of font size, contrast, and voice commands in order to adjust to various disabilities. The ability of AccessArc also empowers the caregivers to manage the resources of the ones they care for with maximum efficiency. AccessArc empowers users to lead more independent lives by emphasizing awareness about underutilized schemes and job opportunities, facilitating workplace diversity.

articleTitle: Gesture and Voice-Based Automation System for Home Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Gesture and voice-based automation innovations are being examined because of the developing interest for reliable and smart home security frameworks. In this study, a MATLAB-based home reconnaissance automation framework in light of voice and motion is created and reproduced. To perceive, interpret, and answer user developments and vocal orders, the proposed framework utilizes modern sign handling and AI calculations. Although nonverbal communication through gestures has been around for a while, gesture-based human-computer interaction (HCI) is growing in popularity in the present day. The conventional interface uses a number of tools, including markers, physical controllers, and gloves, to increase the recognition rate. This work offers a novel marker less method for capturing gestures without the use of expensive gear or any obstacles. In order to enable disabled individuals to operate household appliances using their own speech and gesture commands, we present in this paper a speech and Gesture Driven automation system for homes with a central controller. The framework joins programmed reactions with continuous observation highlights to further develop security, openness, and user solace. Framework reenactment, including control rationale, voice order handling, and motion identification, is finished with MATLAB. The accuracy, reactivity, and common sense of the innovation are shown by the recreation results.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Energy-Efficient Scheduling for Sustainable Digital Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The rapid growth of digital educational services, including video streaming, video conferencing, and virtual project discussions, has revolutionized the learning landscape. While these features have significantly reduced the need for physical travel, they have concurrently escalated the energy demands associated with the operation of electronic devices and supporting digital infrastructure. This paper addresses the environmental and economic impacts of this trend by proposing an AI-driven, energy-efficient scheduling system for educational services. The system aims to optimize the timing of digital educational activities to coincide with periods of low energy demand and high renewable energy production, thereby reducing carbon emissions and operational costs. Current collaborative tools offer limited functionalities for optimizing energy efficiency, resulting in suboptimal energy usage, inefficient harnessing of renewable energy sources, and overlooked economic savings from variable energy tariffs. Our proposed intelligent system analyzes energy consumption patterns, interfaces with renewable energy generation data, and recommends optimal scheduling windows. This approach seeks to mitigate the environmental impact of virtual educational offerings and promote sustainable business practices, ultimately fostering more eco-friendly digital learning environments.

publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: AI in cybersecurity has been gaining ground for years now, and it is used to help manage threats beyond monolithic cyber-attacks. articleTitle: Leveraging AI and Machine Learning for Enhanced Fraud Detection in Digital Banking System: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The merger of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies has drastically changed the field of fraud detection in digital banking in recent years. The increasing frequency of digital transactions in contemporary financial systems has increased the risk of credit card fraud (CCF), necessitating the use of effective detection techniques. Despite the potential of machine learning (ML) technology, dataset imbalance limits the accuracy of fraud detection. This study examines how well data balancing strategies and ensemble learning approaches can identify CCF in unbalanced datasets. This study examines how well data balancing strategies and ensemble learning approaches can identify CCF in unbalanced datasets. In addition to evaluating data balancing strategies like SMOTE, ADASYN, and Random Oversampling, we examine four machine learning algorithms: KNN, Decision Tree, SVM, and LSTM. Significant gains were made by using balancing techniques: The greatest results are obtained with ROS on LSTM, with Recall 89.6%, F1-Score 91.5% and Precision 98.4%, With Precision 97.6%, Recall 91.5%, and F1-Score 93.9%, Random Oversampling ranks second on SVM, whereas SWOT on SVM is third with Precision 91.7%, Recall 86.3%, and F1-Score 89.9 %. The study's findings demonstrate that using SVM and LSTM classifiers in conjunction with oversampling strategies like Random Oversampling yields precise and unaffected results for identifying CCF in unbalanced datasets, assisting in the development of trustworthy fraud detection systems for practical uses.

articleTitle: Computational Approaches to Molecular Dynamics Simulation for Drug Design and Discovery
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Since they offer profound insights into the atomic-level interactions between drug candidates and their biological targets, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations have become extremely effective computational tools for drug design and discovery. MD simulations allow for the estimation of binding affinities, conformational modifications, and the investigation of possible binding sites by simulating the dynamic behaviour of biomolecules over time. These simulations now run much faster and are more accurate thanks to recent improvements in computing power, improved algorithms, and machine learning incorporation. Methods like adaptive sampling and accelerated MD further maximise resource utilisation, making it easier to simulate intricate biological processes in realistic timescales. Furthermore, opportunities for accurate electronic structure analysis have been created by combining MD with quantum mechanical techniques. This presentation highlights how computational methods in MD simulations for drug design can revolutionise the process by supplying crucial information for structure-based drug discovery and promoting the creation of new therapeutic agents with improved efficacy and selectivity.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Self-Management of Diabetes Using Wearable Devices and Machine Learning Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: In order to lessen the burden on medical systems and improve patient results, the increasing incidence of diabetes has called for creative strategies for early identification and efficient self-management. When combined with machine learning (ML) applications, wearable technology has the potential to revolutionise the treatment of diabetes. These gadgets can continuously check vital physiological indicators including blood sugar levels, heart rate, activity patterns, and sleep quality since they are outfitted with sophisticated biosensors. This rich data stream may be analysed to find patterns, forecast trends, and offer tailored suggestions owing to the incorporation of ML techniques. ML-driven methods that use information from wearable technology and other medical sources to identify early indicators of glucose dysregulation-often before clinical symptoms appear-help predict diabetes upfront. Simultaneously, ML-powered self-management technologies assist people in making the best lifestyle decisions possible by offering real-time feedback and forecast insights. articleTitle: Telemedicine and AI: Revolutionizing Healthcare Access Through Advanced Electronics in Rural and Underserved Regions
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Telemedicine is an intriguing approach that uses telecommunication to offer medical services in rural and underserved regions in India. It facilitates interaction among providers and patients, ensuring health services are more cost-effective and readily available. Telemedicine can help advance optimal diabetes management in a variety of ways. It is employed to raise consciousness about diabetes risk variables and treatment among rural and underserved regions, track patients remotely, evaluate for diabetic glucose levels, and avert diabetes at various stages. Electronic gadgets can serve as data visualizing and decision assistance aids for insulin doses. This paper presents a remote tracking system for diabetes management, utilizing electronic medical gadgets, smartwatches, and phones. A machine learning framework was created to detect diabetes risk and facilitate diabetes management. This study attained competing accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity evaluations (83.3%, 78%, and 87.3%) using a 10-fold layered cross-validation approach. publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: VANETs, or vehicle impromptu networks, offer an efficient facility for applications requiring transportation systems with intelligence (ITS). In Communication using VANET, roadside units (RSUs) are the primary element of connections between vehicles and infrastructure. Two major performance problems were identified by analysing cognitive radio (CR)-VANET studies: high latency and energy usage. A vehicle ad hoc network is one way to regulate congestion, provide entertainment, and improve highway security (VANET). VANET's spectrum shortage problems require the Combining cognitive radio (CR), sometimes referred to as CRYANET. CR-VANET's issues have been the subject of numerous research projects. articleTitle: Autism Spectrum Disorder Diagnosis Using Neuroimaging Based on Convolutional Neural Networks and Particle Swarm Optimisation
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: This study presents an automated diagnosis system using structural magnetic resonance images (sMRI) for autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The system is built around a Con-volutional neural network (CNN) architecture, this framework optimises its hyperparameters for improved performance using Particle swarm optimisation (PSO). Preprocessing and training are the two main stages of the model's development. During the preprocessing stage, black and hazy images were removed from the dataset to maintain data integrity. The remaining images were then scaled to fit the model's required input dimensions. In order to maximise learning and maintain the differentiation between normally developing (TD) and ASD groups, it was imperative to take this step to guarantee that the data input into the CNN was uniform and clean. The learning rate and network depth of the CNN are two hyperparameters that are adjusted during the training phase using PSO, and it finds the best configurations by imitating the behaviour of swarms. As a result, the suggested diagnosis approach for Autism Spectrum Disorder that makes use of structural MRI and a CNN that has been upgraded using PSO achieves an outstanding 85.0% accuracy rate. The reliability of the model is configured through five-fold cross-validation, ensuring its robustness and consistency. The model's performance is further highlighted by comparing it with recent studies and commonly used optimizing models, where it demonstrates significant improvements in accuracy and diagnostic efficiency.

We assess the efficiency of smart appliances, lighting controls, and thermostats in reducing energy use using machine learning algorithms. According to our research, customer adoption rates are increased by personalised suggestions and predictive analytics, and engagement is further increased by incentives like government subsidies. Smart home users' clustering assessment reveals unique behavioural patterns that support focused marketing campaigns. Furthermore, sentiment analysis of customer reviews shows that smart home solutions are often seen favourably. articleTitle: Adaptive Electric Vehicle Charge Controllers Using Deep Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: The increasing adoption of electric vehicles necessitates intelligent charging systems to address challenges such as grid overload, renewable energy integration, and user prioritization. This paper presents a new framework in optimizing the efficiency of electric car charging: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning. In this architecture, a global coordinator relies on Proximal Policy Optimization to coordinate across stations, and the local agents follow Deep Q-Networks to manage their resources at the station level. Test results: A comparison of the test results with regular methods shows an average waiting time reduced by 30%, a 15% increase in the usage of renewable energy, and a reduction of 22% in the system latency. For grid loads, consistent results from the operation of this architecture ensure that minimal unserved energy demand leads to the balanced serving of loads. This method, therefore, aligns well with sustainable energy goals through simultaneous improvement in effectiveness of charging infrastructure and on the flexible scale of solution.

articleTitle: Development of a Model to Identify Fake News using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 First International Conference on Advances in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Technologies (CE2CT)
abstract: Various attempts have been made to identify different types of misinformation because news-related misinformation proves to be a major societal concern. The process of identifying genuine news requires supplementary information aligned with social media usage or social engagement functions to be provided. I dedicate this paper to establish two distinct categories for online news articles with the aid of artificial intelligence research combined with linguistic analysis and machine learning techniques. This process enables users to verify the authenticity of presented news content by sharing validation responsibilities which results in either valid or invalid classification.

abstract: This research presents a comprehensive methodology for short-term price forecasting of orange and cotton crops in the Indian agricultural market, utilizing a robust dataset from the Indian Government. The study employs a series of machine learning algorithms, including Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Linear Regression (LR), and Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), which serves as a benchmark for comparative analysis. Data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and feature engineering were conducted to address challenges posed by missing values and to extract significant patterns from the dataset. The results demonstrate the model's effectiveness in accurately predicting crop prices across various geographic and seasonal contexts. The study highlights the implications of identified trends for decision making within the agricultural supply chain, emphasizing the potential for enhanced resilience and sustain ability in India's agricultural sector. Future work will focus on refining the model for broader applications, addressing evolving market dynamics, and integrating additional external factors influencing crop prices.

abstract: Due to the current development of networked systems and the emergence of global cyber threats, efficient and fast NIDS are required.
